jobs.title: Business - Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings
  
We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem\-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out\-of\-the\-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.
  
  

As an ESOP, each of our employee\-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people\-first culture and diverse portfolio of world\-class facilities.
  
  

It's What We Do
  
We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high\-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission\-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.
  
  

It's How We're Different
  
We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee\-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream\-up innovative solutions for our clients industry\-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t\_uJ\-A?si\=oSMy5zQeUcb\_faE3
  
  

Position Summary
  
Project Coordinators support Project Managers in organizing and executing projects by managing schedules, deliverables, documentation, and communication. While not responsible for leading projects, they are expected to develop a project management mindset—actively learning how projects are structured, tracked, and delivered. This role serves as an entry point into project management while building foundational knowledge of engineering design, construction practices, and project delivery processes.
  
.
  
  

Essential Job Functions \& Accountabilities
  
Project Management
  
* Supports project execution and coordination with increasing independence under the direction of the Project Manager.
* Assists in the development of project proposals and contract coordination to build foundational knowledge of scope, fee, and delivery planning.
* Coordinates the development and tracking of project deliverables.
* Assists in the scheduling and assignment of tasks to internal team members.
* Organizes, attends, and documents project meetings with attention to follow\-through and accountability.
* Supports internal and external project communication to ensure consistent information sharing across stakeholders.
* Maintains and monitors project plans, schedules, work hours, budgets, and expenditures.
* Actively shadows Project Managers to build skills in communication, coordination, influence, and professional judgment.


Program Management (where applicable)
  
* Supports fee development, project setup and scoping practices for program projects.
* Assists in coordinating client service and communication across designated program efforts.


Quality
  
* Assists with communicating and coordinating project quality expectations.
* Helps maintain project quality documentation and supports the quality review process.
* Identifies project\-related issues and proactively works with the Project Manager to support resolution.


Client Experience
  
* Serves as a secondary point of contact on select project tasks.
* Partners with the Project Manager to ensure client needs and perspectives are considered in project execution.
* Supports resolution of project\-related issues and coordinates responses to client inquiries.
* Assists Project Managers with client relationship maintenance and business development efforts as requested.


Core Competencies
  
  

Communication
  
* Keeps others informed conveying information clearly and with an appropriate level of detail
* Listens attentively to others and takes an interest in what they have to say
* Responds openly to others encouraging honest, productive communication


Integrity
  
* Demonstrates consideration for the opinions, perspectives, and experiences others
* Takes responsibility for personal actions and delivers on commitments
* Aims to understand how actions impact others


Quality Orientation
  
* Takes steps to ensure work is done correctly
* Delivers on client expectations
* Strives to follow policies and procedures


Teamwork/Inclusion
  
* Shares time and effort with others
* Takes interest and learns from the diversity of others
* Shows enthusiasm for team goals


Continuous Learning
  
* Views mistakes as a growth opportunity
* Recognizes gaps in personal knowledge and pursues opportunities to learn
* Engages others when tackling an unfamiliar task or responsibility


Functional/Technical Expertise
  
* Recognizes routine problems and identify solutions
* Keeps up with industry and/or discipline standards
* Maintains best practice throughout all job functions


Required Education, Experience, Licenses \& Technical Competencies
  
* Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred
* 4 years of relevant experience required, with 2 years cumulative of project support experience
* Basic understanding of project execution required
* Basic understanding of building design and construction principles required
* Self\-starter with the ability to influence and motivate others to achieve goals
* Successful track record of effective collaboration, communication and organization skills.
* Must demonstrate proficiency in all core competencies as described in this job description.

**Location**: California

4\. Basic English communication skills; Spanish speaker is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**



At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high\-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next\-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory\-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

  


**The Team**



As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high\-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.

  


**The Role**



We're seeking a Recruiting Coordinator to support our Talent team and own the logistics, coordination, and candidate experience across the hiring process. This role is critical to our ability to scale—ensuring candidates move quickly, interviews run seamlessly, and every interaction reflects the high bar we set for our team. We're looking for someone who's energized by ambiguity, excited to build from the ground up, and quick to take initiative. This is a fully on\-site role based at our Torrance, CA headquarters.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Schedule phone, video, and onsite interviews across multiple teams and time zones with speed and accuracy.
* Deliver a high\-quality candidate experience through clear communication, attention to detail, and confident onsite hosting.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and workflows in our Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse).
* Coordinate candidate travel (flights, hotels, transportation) and support expense reconciliation.
* Improve recruiting operations through process enhancements and special projects.
* Build strong, professional relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring teams across the business to keep the hiring process moving.

  


**Basic Qualifications**


* Experience managing complex calendars and using tools such as Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer\-service mindset.
* High level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Torrance, CA.

  


**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* 2\+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, or HR coordination.
* Experience using Greenhouse or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience improving or streamlining recruiting or operational processes.

  


**What We Offer**


* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite
* Generous PPE stipend
* High\-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

  


**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**



Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.



We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.



Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

jobs.title: National Sales Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**National Sales Coordinator – Sales Support \& Customer Operations**
---------------------------------------------------------------------


**Full\-Time • Non\-Exempt • Office\-Based • Monday–Friday (Hybrid)**



We are seeking a detail\-oriented and customer\-focused **National Sales Coordinator** to join our team. In this fast\-paced, high\-volume role, you will serve as a key point of contact for customers and the Outside Sales team—managing inbound inquiries, processing orders, and ensuring a seamless customer experience from quote to delivery.



If you thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy multitasking, and take pride in delivering exceptional service while maintaining accuracy, this is a great opportunity to make a meaningful impact.



**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Serve as the primary contact for a high volume of inbound customer and Outside Sales inquiries related to product availability, pricing, order status, invoices, and order processing.
* Prepare and enter customer quotations into SAP, ensuring accuracy in pricing, product availability, and documentation.
* Accurately process sales orders, including pricing, payment terms, freight terms, and delivery timelines.
* Communicate order confirmations and proactively notify customers of any updates or changes.
* Monitor open orders and backorders; follow up regularly to ensure accurate lead times and timely customer communication.
* Coordinate closely with inventory and supply chain teams to resolve held or delayed orders and provide detailed updates.
* Partner with Outside Sales representatives to support customer accounts and maintain strong internal collaboration.
* Resolve customer issues and inquiries promptly, professionally, and with a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of company products and equipment to effectively support customers and sales initiatives.
* Perform additional duties as assigned to support business needs.

**What You Bring**
------------------


### **Experience \& Education**


* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* 3–5 years of experience in customer service, sales support, or order processing in a high\-volume environment.
* Experience in a call center or similar fast\-paced setting preferred.

### **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills**


* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to professionally engage with customers, sales teams, and cross\-functional departments.
* Customer\-first mindset with strong problem\-resolution abilities.

### **Technical \& Systems Skills**


* Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems preferred.
* Ability to learn and navigate internal systems and product information quickly.

### **Operational \& Organizational Skills**


* Highly detail\-oriented with strong multitasking and time management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with sound decision\-making.

### **Additional Qualifications**


* Ability to interpret company policies, procedures, and product information.
* Basic math skills, including calculating pricing adjustments, discounts, and freight percentages.
* Demonstrated professionalism, reliability, and a strong work ethic.
* Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------


* Primarily sedentary role requiring extended periods of sitting.
* Frequent use of hands for typing, handling documents, and computer work.
* Regular communication via phone and computer.
* Occasional standing and walking.
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds occasionally.
* Close vision required for computer\-based tasks.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

  


**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------


* $24\.00\-$26\.00/hr
* 11 paid Holidays
* Generous Paid Time Off — accrue up to 4 weeks per year
* Excellent Benefits Package starting the 1st of the month after 30 days of employment, including:
	+ Medical, Dental \& Vision (including orthodontics)
	+ Company‑paid Life, AD\&D, Short‑Term \& Long‑Term Disability
	+ Flex Spending Account (FSA), accident plans, and supplemental options
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 annually
* MetLife Hyatt Legal
* Employee Assistance Program
  

*Multiquip provides competitive pay and benefits and supports our employees through our values of safety, integrity and respect.*  

*Employment is subject to pre\-employment physical, drug\-screening and background investigation. E\-Verify (www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify) is used to verify a candidates' legal right to work in the U.S.*  

*Multiquip Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will received consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other protected class.*

jobs.title: HR Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** HR Operations Coordinator

**DEPARTMENT:** Human Resources \& Operations

**REPORTS TO:** Human Resources Manager / Executive Leadership

**JOB TYPE:** Full\-time, non\-exempt

**WORK LOCATION:** In office, no remote work

**WORK SCHEDULE:** 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM, Monday through Friday

**STARTING PAY RANGE:** $22\.00 to $24\.00/hr (based on experience)

**Position Summary**

The HR Operations Coordinator plays an important role in supporting our employees and ensuring the smooth, efficient operation of day\-to\-day HR processes. This position is hands\-on and detail\-oriented, with responsibility for maintaining employee records and documentation, managing time\-off calendars, coordinating administrative workflows, and providing responsive employee support.

As a first point of contact, the HR Operations Coordinator will help employees navigate questions, concerns, grievances, and complaints with professionalism, discretion, and objectivity. The HR Operations Coordinator should be approachable and solutions\-oriented.

The ideal candidate is self\-motivated, detail\-oriented professional who brings a positive attitude and strong communication and organizational skills to the role. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment, able to work independently with minimal supervision, and equally effective collaborating with colleagues across the organization.

**Essential job duties and responsibilities:** 

*Employee Relations \& Initial Intake Support*

* Serve as an approachable first point of contact for employees regarding workplace concerns, policy questions, and general inquiries.
* Conduct neutral, initial intake of employee grievances, interpersonal conflicts, and formal complaints; document statements accurately and escalate promptly to executive leadership.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive employee relations matters and documentation.
* Assist leadership in preparing standard documentation for performance counseling, disciplinary notices, and separation packets.

*Time\-Off Administration \& Records*

* Receive and review manually submitted Time Off Requests (TORs).
* Print approved TORs for physical employee records and update the master company/department time\-off calendars accurately, as needed.
* Assist managers and staff with routine questions regarding time\-off availability and company leave policies.

*Onboarding, Offboarding \& Compliance Logistics*

* Assemble new hire orientation packages, coordinate pre\-employment documentation, and verify Form I\-9 compliance.
* Guide incoming staff through Day\-1 administrative onboarding and policy acknowledgments.
* Prepare standard separation paperwork, exit documentation, and coordinate the collection of company property upon employee departures.
* Assist in tracking completion rosters for annual mandatory training (e.g., Harassment Prevention).

*General HR Administration \& File Maintenance*

* Digitize, file, and organize physical and electronic personnel records, ensuring compliance with state and federal record retention laws.
* Handle general HR clerical duties, including drafting routine verification of employment letters, sorting department mail, and maintaining office forms.
* Other HR administrative tasks as assigned.

**Education and work experience:** 

* Education: Minimum high school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s degree or coursework in Human Resources, Business, or related fields preferred.
* Work experience: 1 to 3 years of hands\-on administrative or human resources experience

**Knowledge and skills:**

* High emotional intelligence, active listening skills, and an objective, professional demeanor when handling sensitive workplace concerns.
* Strong organizational skills and precision with calendar management and document tracking.
* Absolute commitment to confidentiality and ethical discretion.
* Basic familiarity with workplace policies, standard documentation practices, and labor standards.
* Working proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) or Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar).

**Physical demands:**

Primary functions require sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in an office setting, including but not limited to:

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer screen.
* Frequent typing, scanning, filing, and reading detailed paper and digital records.
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching to access filing cabinets.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**



At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces \- we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee\-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company's long\-term success.

  


**Job Summary**



The Assistant Project Manager (APM) is a core team member responsible for managing project change orders, subcontractor coordination, and project documentation with a high level of independence and accountability. The APM understands the financial, administrative, and logistical elements of construction and supports both internal teams and client\-facing communications.

  


**Responsibilities and Duties**


* Lead the preparation of Change Orders from inception to PO issuance, including detailed pricing review and subcontractor negotiation.
* Fully level subcontractor proposals and scopes of work, flagging any discrepancies or risks.
* Manage procurement timelines and coordination of long\-lead items.
* Maintain ownership of the project submittal log and escalation of critical items.
* Understand, update, and track Schedule of Events (SOE) and project milestones.
* Work directly with the Superintendent to establish the Subcontractor Build Schedule.
* Take lead on the project financial close\-out process, including reconciliation of POs, billing, and retention.
* Proactively communicate with internal and external stakeholders, including leading subcontractor meetings when needed.
* Identify and escalate potential scope or financial risks; contribute to resolution strategies.
* Mentor and support Project Engineers and Project Coordinators.

  


**Qualifications and Skills**


* Proficient to advanced knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, and project logistics.
* Solid understanding of subcontract scopes, sequencing, and project budget impacts.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Procore, MS Project; working knowledge of Timberline.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure and lead through challenges.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt tone and detail level to audience.
* Adheres to and exemplifies JRM's Core Values.

  


**Computer Systems**


* Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook), Timberline (preferred but not required), On\-Screen Takeoff (preferred but not required)

  


**Salary Information**


* To the extent this position is performed in California, the annual salary range for this role is $90,000 \- $120,000\.


\#LI\-OnSite

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at JRM without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.*

  


*The salary range listed in job postings reflects the Company's good\-faith estimate at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as position tier, geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training, and skills.*

  


*For more information on how JRM Construction Management collects and uses your personal information, reference our* *Privacy Policy**.*

jobs.title: Platform Support & Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
People Science is looking for a **Platform Support \& Implementation Specialist** to join our team. This is a unique opportunity to be a part of a small team who is looking to empower humanity with the tools and knowledge of science and medicine to improve ourselves, our communities, and our world by making research tools accessible and understandable.

People Science runs decentralized clinical trials, and we build the platform they run on. Chloe is our study platform: participant journeys, eCOA, data capture, and reporting for trials that happen in people's homes rather than in clinic. We operate as both a full\-service CRO and a software company, which means the people who build the product sit close to the people running the studies. We work with commercial sponsors and, increasingly, with academic medical centers and research institutions who want to run remote and hybrid studies without building the infrastructure themselves. We're a small team, venture\-backed, and growing fast.

**Job Summary**   
You are the person who makes Chloe work for the people using it, both our software clients and our own internal study teams. When a sponsor's coordinator can't figure out why a participant didn't get a scheduled assessment, you're who they ask. When a PI at an academic medical center wants to know whether their longitudinal protocol can actually be built, you're who can answer. When we ship a new feature, you're who teaches the Clinical Operations team how to use it, and you're who writes the article so nobody has to ask twice. Over time the job is less about answering questions and more about making sure the question stops getting asked.

This is a newly scoped role. You'd be the first person in it, which means real influence over how platform support works here.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**  
**Support our software clients.** Own day\-to\-day platform support for our commercial and academic software clients: sponsors, CROs, ingredient suppliers, and research institutions who license Chloe and run their own studies on it. Diagnose issues, distinguish “the platform has a bug” from “the study is configured in a way that produces this,” resolve what you can, and escalate what you can't with enough detail that engineering doesn't have to reproduce it from scratch.

**Own internal enablement.** Our Clinical Operations project managers and study builders are in Chloe every day. You'll own keeping them current: run the training when we release, build the reference material, and be the first stop for platform questions from the study teams.

**Own the knowledge base.** Take our client and internal facing documentation and make it the thing people search first and trust. Write it, keep it current as the product changes, and measure whether it's reducing inbound volume.

**Support new client onboarding.** Help get new software clients configured, trained, and live, working alongside product and Clinical Operations. Ideally you can take an academic implementation and own it yourself: translate the protocol into a working configuration, run UAT, get the team to go\-live, and stay available through the early weeks of enrollment, when the real questions surface.

**Reduce your own queue.** A real expectation, not a flourish. We want you to notice the ticket you've now answered nine times and go fix the underlying thing: a confusing label, a missing default, a documentation gap, a workflow that needs a product change. You'll bring those to product with a recommendation attached.

**What We Are Looking For**  
We care much more about how you think than about your exact title history. A research coordinator who has built complex study instruments and is genuinely good with software will do better here than a career support rep who has never seen a protocol.

**Required**

* 3\+ years in clinical research operations, including time in academic or institutional research: research coordinator, research program manager, clinical research informatics, CRC, CRA, clinical data, or site management at a university, academic medical center, research institute, CRO, or sponsor. You know what an IRB submission involves and why a coordinator's week looks the way it does.
* Hands\-on experience building study instruments in an EDC, REDCap in particular: designing projects, longitudinal designs, branching logic, surveys, data dictionaries, exports. If you're the person your department comes to with REDCap problems, we want to talk to you.
* Strong protocol literacy. You can read a protocol and identify the operational and technical problems in it before anyone builds anything.
* Experience supporting people outside your own team: external clients, study sites, investigators, or vendors. You can hold a room with a PI who is skeptical and short on time.
* Real comfort with software as a system, not just as a user. You've been the person on your team who figured out the tool everyone else avoided.
* Clear, direct written communication. Much of this job is writing: tickets, articles, explanations.
* Genuinely self\-directed. The most important trait for this role. When you hit something you don't know, your instinct is to dig into the protocol, the configuration, and the documentation and come back with “here's what I think is happening and here's what I'd do,” not “what should I do?”
* Fluent with AI tools in your actual daily work. This is a requirement, not a perk. A meaningful part of this job, including knowledge base content, first\-draft responses, mapping a REDCap data dictionary onto a Chloe configuration, pulling data out of analytics tools, and summarizing what changed in a release, gets dramatically faster if you're good with AI tools, and we've scoped the role assuming you are. We're looking for someone who already reaches for these tools without being told to, and who has developed judgment about where they help and where they produce confident nonsense. jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Marketing Coordinator**

**Cole Services — Garden Grove, California**  
**Full\-Time \| In\-Person**  
**Salary: $55,000–$75,000 per year, based on experience, plus benefits**

**Help Us Build a 57\-Year\-Old Brand—and Drive Its Next Stage of Growth**

Most marketing coordinator positions focus on posting content, ordering promotional materials, and completing tasks assigned by someone else.

This position is different.

Cole Services is looking for a driven **Marketing Coordinator** who wants ownership, measurable goals, and the opportunity to directly influence the growth of an established home\-service company.

A major focus of this position will be growing our **Cole Comfort Club membership program** by developing campaigns that turn new and existing customers into long\-term members.

If you enjoy creating marketing campaigns, building customer loyalty, tracking results, and turning ideas into action, this may be the opportunity you have been looking for.

**Who We Are**

Cole Services is the **oldest privately held home\-service company in Orange County**. For more than 57 years, we have served Southern California homeowners with plumbing, heating, air\-conditioning, drain, sewer, and electrical services.

We were also voted a **Top Place to Work in 2025**.

We are proud of our history, but we are even more excited about our future. We believe in high standards, continuous improvement, measurable performance, excellent customer service, and creating long\-term career opportunities for our employees.

This is not a corporate position where your ideas disappear into endless meetings. You will work closely with company leadership, see the results of your work, and help shape our next stage of growth.

**What You Will Own**

**Marketing Campaigns**

* Coordinate direct\-mail, email, social\-media, referral, community, customer\-retention, and membership campaigns.
* Maintain the company’s annual marketing calendar and ensure campaigns launch on schedule.
* Help create compelling offers, advertisements, emails, social\-media content, customer communications, and promotional materials.
* Coordinate with outside marketing partners, printers, designers, photographers, and vendors.
* Protect and strengthen the Cole Services brand across every customer touchpoint.
* Help communicate what makes Cole Services different from other home\-service companies.
* Promote our history as Orange County’s oldest privately held home\-service company.
* Help showcase our recognition as a 2025 Top Place to Work.

**Cole Comfort Club Membership Growth**

* Develop and coordinate campaigns that increase Cole Comfort Club memberships.
* Market membership benefits to our existing customer database.
* Create email, direct\-mail, social\-media, and customer follow\-up campaigns focused on membership enrollment.
* Work with customer service representatives, dispatchers, technicians, managers, and salespeople to improve membership presentation and conversion.
* Monitor membership sales by employee, department, campaign, and customer type.
* Identify opportunities to convert past customers into active members.
* Create campaigns that improve member engagement, retention, and renewal rates.
* Help develop employee contests, recognition programs, and internal communication around membership goals.
* Track cancellations and help identify ways to reduce membership loss.
* Maintain accurate membership reports and communicate progress to leadership.
* Help Cole Services build one of the strongest home\-service membership programs in Southern California.

**Marketing Performance and Reporting**

* Track leads, booked calls, new customers, membership enrollments, campaign revenue, cost per lead, and return on marketing investment.
* Use ServiceTitan and company reports to identify which campaigns are producing results.
* Help determine which marketing channels should be increased, improved, or discontinued.
* Prepare clear weekly and monthly marketing reports for leadership.
* Make recommendations based on actual results—not opinions or vanity metrics.
* Help generate customer reviews, testimonials, employee stories, and completed\-project content.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

This is a results\-based position. The Marketing Coordinator’s scorecard will include:

* New Cole Comfort Club memberships
* Membership conversion rate
* Membership retention and cancellation rate
* Leads and booked calls generated
* New customers acquired
* Cost per lead
* Campaign revenue
* Return on marketing investment
* Customer\-review growth
* Email and direct\-mail campaign performance
* Marketing projects completed accurately and on time

**The Person We Are Looking For**

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Take ownership without needing constant supervision.
* Are organized enough to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Can write clear and persuasive marketing content.
* Understand how to market value—not simply discounts.
* Are comfortable working with numbers, reports, budgets, and performance goals.
* Understand that activity is important, but measurable results matter more.
* Communicate professionally with employees, customers, managers, and outside vendors.
* Look for solutions when a campaign is not working.
* Enjoy moving quickly in an accountable, growth\-oriented environment.
* Believe that **how you do anything is how you do everything**.

Experience in home services, membership marketing, customer retention, direct mail, email marketing, social media, ServiceTitan, or a similar CRM system is valuable. However, ownership, resourcefulness, creativity, and demonstrated results are equally important.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* **Annual salary of $55,000–$75,000, based on experience**
* Company benefits according to eligibility and plan terms
* Direct access to company leadership
* Clear expectations and measurable goals
* Opportunities for professional development and increased responsibility

jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world's most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production\-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.



Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

**Purpose**
-----------



We are seeking a highly organized and proactive **Recruiting Coordinator** to join our growing Talent team. The Recruiting Coordinator will be a central point of contact for candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a seamless and positive experience throughout the recruitment process. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and is passionate about enabling teams to hire the best talent.


**The Role**
------------


* **Candidate Experience:** Manage scheduling of interviews, candidate communication, and travel arrangements while ensuring a world\-class candidate journey.
* **Hiring Team Support:** Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to coordinate interview logistics, panel alignment, and feedback collection.
* **Process Management:** Maintain accurate data in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), monitor pipelines, and prepare candidate status reports.
* **Employer Branding:** Assist in creating and posting job descriptions, career site updates, and support recruiting events or initiatives that showcase Divergent's culture.
* **Operational Excellence:** Identify opportunities to improve scheduling workflows, communication touchpoints, and recruiting operations.
* **Confidentiality:** Handle sensitive candidate and company information with discretion and professionalism.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
* 1\+ years in recruiting coordination, HR, or administrative support (tech or manufacturing environment preferred).
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a focus on candidate care.
* Proficiency with ATS platforms (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever, or similar) and scheduling tools (e.g., Outlook, Google Workspace).
* A team\-first mindset, flexibility, and eagerness to contribute to a mission\-driven organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience with Greenhouse ATS.
* Experience in fast\-paced start\-up environments.
* Experience supporting university recruiting or internship programs.

 **What We Offer:**


* **Holistic Compensation Package:** Enjoy a world\-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results\-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
* **Wellness and Time Off:** Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year\-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
* **Comprehensive Health and Wellness:** Prioritize your well\-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company\-sponsored life insurance and short and long\-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
* **Investment in Growth:** We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
* **Collaborative and High\-Performing Environment:** Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high\-performing team within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

  

  

***Equal Employment Opportunity***  

*Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.*  

*EEO Poster*


*In order to adjust to changes in our business, it may become necessary to add, remove or modify certain duties and responsibilities, or to reassign you to another job position. From time to time you may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected.*  

  

***E\-Verify: Right to Work***  

*Our company participates in* *E\-Verify**. E\-Verify is a program that electronically confirms a candidate's eligibility to work in the United States after completing the Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I\-9\). **SUMMARY**



The Los Angeles County Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH)consolidates our countywide response to homelessness. The driving force behind HSH is increasing accountability and transparency, improving care for people experiencing or at risk of homelessness, and streamlining collaboration with partners including services providers, the County’s 88 cities, and unincorporated areas to deliver high\-quality, life\-saving care. Staff schedules are based on business need and may include the option of a hybrid work schedule where employees work remotely and from the office.



The Homeless Prevention Unit (HPU) is a collaborative effort between HSH, California Policy Lab (CPL) and the Department of Mental Health (DMH). The HPU proactively identifies individuals who are most at risk of homelessness through predictive analytics and provides them with flexible, early interventions to resolve issues that might lead to loss of their housing. HPU is expanding to serve young adults between the ages of 18\-24 in need of proactive homelessness prevention resources. The HPU has significant interactions with several County departments to address challenges navigating service systems and/or to connect or re\-connect individuals to services to ensure housing stability; therefore, the ideal candidate will be knowledgeable in mainstream and specific programs and services tailored to young people at risk of or experiencing homelessness while being flexible to meet the changing needs and demands of the program and this population.



The Medical Case Worker II (Outreach Coordinator) position will perform full\-time proactive outreach for the HPU and will report to the Outreach Program Manager. Working closely with the TAY Case Managers and other HPU supporting staff, this position will be responsible for outreaching to and engaging with prospective clients who are identified as at high risk of experiencing homelessness. The Medical Case Worker II will conduct outreach, gather consents from prospective clients and facilitate warm hand\-offs for long\-term care to HPU Case Managers.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


**Outreach**

* Provides outreach and engagement services to HPU clients in collaboration with Outreach Program Manager and other HPU staff.
* Oversees the coordination of new client assignments, intake, and care coordination with case managers, ensuring a smooth transition from intake process to assessment and enrollment.
* Collaborates with case managers, as needed, by identifying linkages, immediate needs gathering and submitting necessary documentation from clients pre\-enrollment.
* Triages and assesses HPU clients to determine their immediate safety needs as well as appropriate population.
* Reviews DMH and Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH) medical records/databases to determine service history and contact information and coordinate with current service providers as appropriate.
* Identifies potential immediate interventions for early\-stage HPU clients and link them to the resources needed to ensure housing retention including sources of income, short term rental assistance and assistance with arrears or utilities as well as medical, mental health and substance use providers as appropriate and food, clothing, transportation and vocational resources.
* Provides HPU clients with crisis intervention support as needed including assisting clients to access emergency and crisis stabilization services such as the DMH Psychiatric Mobile Response Team (PMRT), mental health urgent care services, medical and/or substance use disorder services.
* Collaborates with HPU clients and family members (when appropriate) to develop and amend treatment plan goals.


**Data \& Project Management**


* Manages and maintains monthly outreach data entry, documentation, and client reassignments.
* Supports Outreach Program manager in the planning of monthly outreach and new client engagement for Case Manager teams work with single adults, families and Transitional Aged Youth (TAY).
* Completes and submits all required documentation in a timely manner to ensure client progress is monitored and outcomes collected.
* Collaborates and coordinates with HPU management to identify and discuss programmatic and data needs as well as obtain consultation as needed on the appropriate level of interventions/services needed to support clients.
* Other duties as assigned.


**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**



One year of experience as a Medical Case Worker I \- OR \- A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and one year of professional casework experience interviewing, counseling, and assisting patients/clients with social problems.


**Certificates/Licenses/Clearances**


* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job\-related essential functions.
* Successful clearance of the Live Scan process with the County of Los Angeles.
* Health clearance required.

jobs.title: TikTok Shop Account Manager - Los Angeles
jobs.description:
### **About Spotlight Media**


Spotlight Media is a leading TikTok Shop Partner agency, scaling some of the most recognizable brands in the new age of social commerce. Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t believe in cookie\-cutter playbooks—every strategy we craft is custom\-built to unlock our clients’ full potential on TikTok Shop. As a TikTok Shop–only agency, our entire focus, from the initiatives we pursue to the talent we hire, is singularly dedicated to driving growth on the platform.


We’ve guided brands through the full funnel\- from launch to scaling into the millions in GMV\-and we’re just getting started.


We believe the future of e\-commerce is social. That’s why we’re building a team of high\-agency individuals who thrive on ownership, autonomy, and speed. Spotlight is not just a place to execute campaigns—it’s a blank canvas where ambitious people can build real leverage, take on increasing responsibility, and grow into senior operators quickly. Our culture is high\-performing, entrepreneurial, and unapologetically ambitious.


Join us, and you’ll have the trust, resources, and runway to redefine what’s possible for the world’s leading brands.

  

### **Role Overview**


We're looking for an **Account Manager** **based in Los Angeles**. This will be a **remote role** but due to our client needs you need to be based in Los Angeles.
  

  

You’ll be the execution engine for TikTok Shop accounts, working directly under a Senior Account Manager. You’ll help translate strategy into action, keep projects moving, maintain shop health, and deliver consistent, high\-quality execution across teams.


This is a **learn\-by\-doing role** designed for high\-agency operators who want to grow fast. Early on, you’ll focus on execution and account operations. As you demonstrate judgment, reliability, and ownership, your scope will expand into growth initiatives, client leadership, and strategy\-**with a clear path to Senior Account Manager typically within 6–12 months** for strong performers.

  

### **What You’ll Do**


Client Operations \& Communication

* Run the account operating rhythm: prep agendas, take notes, track action items, and send crisp recaps for WBRs/MBRs/QBRs.
* Build and maintain 30\-60\-90 day plans for each client; update owners, timelines, and success metrics weekly.
* Draft client updates and deck slides; translate performance data into clear narratives and concrete next steps.
* Manage tickets and issues, chase dependencies, and keep all stakeholders aligned and on timeline.


TikTok Shop Execution \& Health

* Own day\-to\-day Seller Center hygiene: PDP checks (titles, attributes, images), catalog updates, and compliance follow\-ups.
* Monitor and report account\-health metrics (e.g., Late Dispatch Rate, Valid Tracking Rate, cancellations/refunds) and flag risks early.
* Launch and coordinate promotions (bundles, coupons, seasonal events) with Content and Media teams.
* Support troubleshooting for approvals or policy issues by organizing evidence, timelines, and escalation documentation.


Cross\-Functional Orchestration (No Content Creation)

* Write airtight briefs for Content and Creative teams; track revisions against SLAs and quality bars.
* Partner with Media and Analytics on dashboards, UTM hygiene, and weekly performance readouts (GMV, CTR, CVR, AOV, refunds).
* Coordinate with Ops and Logistics on fulfillment readiness and customer experience status.


Data, QA, and Process

* Maintain source\-of\-truth documentation in Notion: trackers, risk logs, promo calendars, and asset libraries.
* Perform QA checks before delivery (accuracy, links, pricing, promo eligibility, compliance).
* Contribute to and improve playbooks and SOPs; capture lessons learned in retros to help the team move faster over time.

### **What You’ll Learn \& Growth Trajectory**

* Shadow your Senior AM on strategy development, escalations, negotiations, and QBR storytelling.
* Gradually take point on client calls, scope changes, and mini\-initiatives (e.g., a seasonal promo or creator activation).
* Expand from execution ownership strategy as you consistently hit scorecard targets.
* **Clear, merit\-based path to Senior Account Manager**, with increasing responsibility, influence, and compensation as your scope grows.

### **Success Metrics**

* **Delivery reliability:** On\-time/on\-brief execution; rework rate trending down.
* **Communication quality:** Clear recaps, fast response times, and strong stakeholder CSAT.
* **Business impact:** Tangible contribution to GMV growth initiatives and promotional performance.

### **You Will Be a Fit If**

* You have a strong familiarity with **beauty and cosmetic brands**.
* You’re a strategic thinker who wants to learn through hands\-on execution.
* You have high agency and enjoy taking ownership without needing constant direction.
* You’re a checklist sniper who loves moving complex projects from “idea” to “done.”
* You write crisp, client\-ready updates and can turn metrics into simple stories with clear actions.
* You’re TikTok\-native and curious about how TikTok Shop mechanics drive conversion.
* You get energy from organizing chaos—briefs, timelines, QA, and follow\-through are your happy place.
* You have a builder mindset: you document, templatize, and leave systems better than you found them.
* You actively seek feedback and want to grow into a Senior AM quickly.

### **What You Bring (Requirements)**

* 1–7\+ years in e\-commerce, marketplaces, digital marketing, consulting, or client\-facing operations (agency experience a plus).
* Strong project management skills: task tracking, timelines, stakeholder coordination.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel; comfort working with dashboards and basic analysis (filters, pivots, lookups).
* Excellent written and verbal communication with a strong service mindset.
* Familiarity with TikTok as a consumer platform and eagerness to master TikTok Shop (we’ll train you on our playbooks).

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------



Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in\-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W\-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in\-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C\-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**



From life\-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.



Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.



Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.



Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in\-space ecosystem.

**About the Role**
------------------



Varda is looking for a highly organized, proactive **People Operations Specialist** to help keep the day\-to\-day People function running smoothly. This role will support recruiting, onboarding, HR administration, and the overall employee experience.



This is a hands\-on role and an important point of contact for candidates, new hires, employees, and managers. The ideal person enjoys being at the center of the action, takes ownership of the details, anticipates what needs to happen next, and helps create a seamless and welcoming experience for employees from candidate through offboarding.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Human Resources Administration**


* Coordinate the new hire onboarding process from accepted offer through the employee's first\-day experience, ensuring all required documentation, systems access, communications, and internal coordination are completed.

* Ensure employee changes are accurately documented and communicated to payroll, benefits, IT, managers, and other appropriate partners in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records, personnel files, organizational information, and HRIS data.
* Support employee offboarding, including coordinating required documentation, internal notifications, system access changes, return of company property, and final\-day logistics.
* Monitor People Operations workflows and follow up with employees and managers to ensure required forms, approvals, and information are completed on time.
* Respond to routine employee questions and help connect employees with the appropriate People team member or resource when additional support is needed.
* Support employee events, recognition programs, communications, engagement activities, and other People initiatives.
* Partner across Recruiting, People Operations, Finance, IT, Facilities, Hospitality, and Administration to ensure employee\-related processes are coordinated and executed smoothly.
* Provide general administrative and project support to the People team, including special projects and evolving priorities as the organization grows.
* Draft and prepare routine HR documentation, including offer letters, promotion and compensation change letters, bonus and recognition award letters, employment verification letters, and other ad hoc employee communications and documents.


**Recruiting Support**


* Provide backup coordination support to the recruitment team when needed.
* Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to ensure a smooth, high\-touch candidate experience.
* Support recruiting events, interview logistics, travel, and recruiting administration.


**Employee Experience**


* Help coordinate the employee shuttle service, including schedules, communications, feedback, and day\-to\-day issues until hospitality team is built out.
* Help ensure employees have seamless, best\-in\-class workplace experience.

--------------------------


* 3\+ years of HR, recruiting coordination, People Operations, or administrative experience.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Strong communication and customer\-service skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* High discretion when handling confidential employee information.
* Proactive, resourceful, and willing to jump in where needed.
* Comfortable working onsite and being a visible, approachable member of the People team.

* Pay range: $30\.00/hr \- $43\.00/hr

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager, ASCS - Amazon Freight
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Freight, a key pillar within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Account Management team. This is a customer facing relationship management role within our commercial organization. You will serve as the primary operational partner for Amazon Freight's largest enterprise shippers, owning the customer relationship, identifying systemic issues that impact their experience, and coordinating cross functional teams to drive resolution.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the enterprise customer operational relationship across all freight modes (TL, IMDL, LTL), serving as the single threaded point of contact for your accounts' operational points of contact
* Identify systemic operational defects impacting your accounts using performance dashboards and customer feedback. Quantify the problem in dollars, loads, and retention risk
* Coordinate cross functional teams to resolution: gather customer insights, understand requirements, bring the right internal teams together, align on the path forward, and ensure we deliver. You don't solve problems alone but you own making sure they get solved
* Own the customer facing performance narrative. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, produce recovery plans during performance degradation, and proactively communicate progress on open issues with timelines and measurable targets
* Own escalation communication to customer executives when something goes wrong: what's happening, what we're doing about it, and how we're tracking toward resolution
* Own internal reporting, including MBRs, account bridges, and leading inspection mechanisms for your accounts. Report out on performance metrics, cost inputs, and customer KPIs
* Influence customer operations to drive optimal inputs that lower our costs. Define what good looks like, measure it, and partner with customers to change how they operate
* Activate structured recovery programs before the customer escalates

  

A day in the life  

Your day starts with account health dashboards, spotting a detention\-charge trend at one customer's facilities and digging into its cause. By midmorning you're briefing a customer's regional transportation director on performance, then rallying ops and pricing partners on a structural issue hitting multiple facilities. After lunch you build your MBR narrative, quantifying your team's impact and open items. Later you lead a working session with operations and product on a fix to prevent recurring defects, then close by updating a customer VP on a two\-week escalation, showing progress against committed targets.  

  

About the team  

The Enterprise Customer Success team is newly formed within Amazon Freight's commercial organization. This team serves as the single threaded relationship owner for our largest customers' operational points of contact. We exist to ensure that every enterprise shipper on our platform experiences the service level we committed to, and when they don't, we coordinate the teams that fix it.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience positioning and selling innovative solutions to new and existing customers and market segments
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

Reporting to the Strategy Director, your mission is to build a thriving community from the ground up by establishing deep trust, swiftly addressing audience issues, and ensuring absolute alignment with strict regulatory compliance. We are a leading assisted reproductive technology (ART) fertility clinic located in Torrance, CA, dedicated to helping individuals and couples build their families. --------------


Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high\-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission\-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  

  

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------


Sift's Business Development Representatives are the front line of our enterprise sales team. You'll own a portfolio of named accounts across aerospace, defense, and industrial engineering, building relationships with the teams designing rockets, satellites, autonomous systems, and other mission\-critical hardware.


This isn't mindless outbound. Success comes from curiosity, research, and good judgment. You'll learn how complex engineering organizations buy software, identify the right technical and executive stakeholders, and secure conversations through thoughtful, personalized outreach. You'll partner closely with an Account Executive to develop account strategy, travel to industry events and customer sites, and use AI\-assisted tooling to research accounts and scale high\-quality outreach.


As one of our early GTM hires, you'll work closely with sales leadership, gain exposure to full enterprise deal cycles, and build the technical and commercial foundation to grow into an Account Executive, sales leadership, or other GTM roles as you succeed.

---------------------

* Own a portfolio of named accounts and drive the outreach strategy for each, from first touch to qualified meeting
* Map account org structures: identify decision\-makers, champions, and technical stakeholders across engineering, procurement, and program leadership
* Prioritize accounts using signals like funding, new leadership, program announcements, and industry news
* Identify new, unnamed opportunities: map emerging markets and adjacent verticals outside your assigned accounts, and make the case for where Sift should expand next

* Partner closely with your assigned AE: align on account strategy, keep pipeline visibility current, and ensure a clean handoff once a meeting is booked (join the first call as needed, but the AE owns prep)
* Keep CRM and account records current and accurate
* Travel to industry events and customer sites when it directly supports a named account
* Use AI\-assisted tooling to synthesize account research and draft outreach efficiently

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 1\-4 years in a customer\-facing, high\-performance environment (B2B sales development, consulting, program or capture support, or similar)
* Strong written communication; able to write outreach that reads as specific and researched, not templated
* Comfortable owning a portfolio and prioritizing without heavy oversight
* Highly self\-motivated, hardworking, and driven, with a track record of finding creative approaches when the obvious path doesn't work
* Genuine curiosity about hard tech, aerospace, defense, or industrial engineering
* Willing to travel for events and customer visits

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience selling into or supporting government/defense programs
* Familiarity with account mapping or capture strategy in complex, multi\-stakeholder orgs
* Experience with Clarify, Salesforce, Apollo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

We are open to **relocating candidates to LA** or **working from our San Francisco** office for the right candidate.

As Client Experience Coordinator, you'll be the first face and voice most of our clients and prospective students encounter \- in person, on the phone, and online. jobs.title: Fixed-Term Curatorial Project Coordinator, Prints & Drawings
jobs.description:
Under the supervision of the Curator\-in\-Charge, the Curatorial Project Coordinator provides support to the curatorial staff for the day\-to\-day operation of the Prints and Drawings Department (Achenbach Foundation for Graphic Arts). This role assists curatorial staff in all areas, including collections records, bibliographic and biographical records and files, research for exhibitions and publications, loans, and general curatorial inquiries.  

This is a 1\-year fixed\-term position, November 2026 \- November 2027\. The application deadline is Friday, September 25, 2026, 9 PM PST.  

Duties and Responsibilities:

* Administration: Participates in the day\-to\-day administrative operations of the department, including in\-house actions required for the permanent collection's maintenance and exhibition; correspondence pertaining to incoming and outgoing loans; inquiries from other institutions, the press, and the public, following institutional and departmental protocol and procedures.
* Research: Participates in the preparation of exhibition research, loans, and related educational materials. Prepares digital presentations, vets art books to be ordered for the Library, and directs research projects.
* Outside Requests: Assists in corresponding with scholars or members of the public regarding objects in the collection. In collaboration with the Assistant Curator, coordinates appointments for the Roberts Seminar Room and hosts classes/groups as necessary.
* Permanent Collection and Documentation: Works with the Registration Department to ensure proper documentation of the collection, including acquisitions, deaccessioning, research, and logistics. Working knowledge of The Museum System (TMS) collections management system is ideal. Maintains departmental files.
* Generates and tracks work progress of technician, conservation, publications, and photo requests, as well as purchase orders required to engage the assistance of other Museum departments in Asana.

* Achenbach Graphic Arts Council: provides administrative support for the Achenbach curatorial support group, liaising with board members, and assisting in organizing board meetings and programs.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

  

Minimum Qualifications:

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in art history and knowledge of graphic arts required; Master’s Degree in Art History preferred.
* Work Experience: At least 2 years of curatorial or academic research experience or other relevant museum experience.

  

Skills and Abilities:

* Good general knowledge of the history and culture of the graphic arts.
* Responsive to supervision and flexible in meeting shifting priorities.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with others.
* Exceptional organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with both traditional and contemporary methods of art history research.
* Ability to conduct directed and independent research.
* Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced work environment with strong follow\-through.
* Exceptional energy, initiative and productivity.
* Ability to achieve and sustain best curatorial practices.
* Strong communication and computer skills, strong customer service orientation.
* Strong arts / aesthetic background and interests.
* Familiarity with standard museum operations and practices is essential.
* Fluency with project management databases (such as Asana) and collections management systems (such as TMS) is preferred.

  

Additional:

  

Schedule: This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule. Hybrid schedules are a minimum of 4 days a week onsite, with the understanding that schedules may change based on operational needs. The workweek is Monday \- Friday, 8 hours a day, 40 hours per week. This is a 1\-year fixed\-term position, November 2026 \- November 2027\.


Compensation: This is a union position eligible for the Museums' benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance and a generous time off package. There is a 7\-step union pay scale for this position: Step 1 (starting rate) is $28\.73 per hour, Step 7 (max rate) is $38\.50\. Generally, new employees start at the beginning of the pay scale.


Application Deadline: Friday, September 25 at 9 PM PST. We plan to launch the interview process in October.  

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources @ famsf.org.

  

\_\_\_


COFAM is the Corporation of Fine Arts Museums and is the privately funded non\-profit corporation which supports the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco, a department of the City and County of San Francisco.


COFAM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a policy of nondiscrimination in all phases of employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Comprising the de Young Museum in Golden Gate Park and the Legion of Honor in Lincoln Park, we are the largest public arts institution in the City of San Francisco and one of the largest art museums in the United States. The de Young, designed by Herzog \& de Meuron and located in Golden Gate Park, showcases American art from the 17th through the 21st centuries, international contemporary art, textiles and costumes, and art from the Americas, the Pacific, and Africa. The Legion of Honor displays a collection of over 4,000 years of ancient and European art including Auguste Rodin's The Thinker and houses the Achenbach Foundation for Graphic Arts in a Beaux\-Arts style building overlooking Lincoln Park and the Golden Gate Bridge.

Our Care Coordination \& Office Operations Team is at the heart of that work. We coordinate referrals, schedules, communication, documentation, credentialing, and billing support while helping clients, nurses, and healthcare partners feel informed and well supported.

The right person enjoys bringing calm and organization to a responsive environment, takes genuine ownership of their work, and follows important details through to completion.

· Manage schedule changes, cancellations, urgent coverage requests, and other time\-sensitive needs.

· Review nursing documentation for completeness and process it promptly.

· Assist with client invoicing, contractor invoice processing, and related follow\-up.

· Maintain accurate scheduling, credentialing, compliance, and operational records.

· Follow written Standard Operating Procedures while helping identify practical workflow improvements.

· Support teammates and participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on\-call coverage.

**Who Thrives Here**

People who thrive at TLC care about doing things well, helping others, and contributing to the organization as a whole. They tend to:

· Take ownership, show initiative, and follow responsibilities through to completion.

· Stay organized, responsive, and attentive to details while managing multiple priorities.

Service request: Monitor AC service requests and take ownership of assigned AE requests

jobs.title: Field Marketing & Growth Lead
jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------


Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high\-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission\-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  

  

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------


San Francisco hard tech is the most alive it has been in years, and Sift just opened an office in the middle of it. We already know how to throw a great event. What we have not done is make the energy travel: the room fills, the night lands, and none of it shows up on Twitter, where the hard tech conversation actually compounds. This is a growth role that fixes that. You will own our events and field program, our hosted community nights out of our SF office, and the job of turning every room we are in into content that moves online. Vibe and funnel carry equal weight here, because they feed each other: the vibe fills the room, the room fills the funnel, and the funnel pays for the next room. You will carry an event\-sourced pipeline number set with the Head of Sales and a talent contribution target set with the Head of Talent.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own the annual event calendar, budget, and the return on it. Run our internal event scoring framework and make the call on every booth, walk, and pass with a rationale attached.
* Build and run our owned event program: dinners, roundtables, and hosted formats that fill without depending on account executives sending personal invites the week of.
* Stand up a recurring San Francisco community program out of our SF office, so the Bay Area hardware and autonomy community has a Sift night on its calendar.
* Make every event ship to the feed. Every event we host or attend produces clips, photos, and posts on Twitter within days. If it was worth hosting, it is worth posting.
* Grow Sift’s Twitter presence into something that carries the energy of the SF hard tech scene, and get the team posting alongside the company account.
* Partner with RevOps to close our attribution gap so every booth, dinner, and sponsorship maps to opportunities and event\-sourced pipeline is a number we can state.
* Turn booth execution into a system: owned assets, a shipping and staffing runbook, a quarterly collateral kit, consistent lead capture, and follow\-up within 48 hours.
* Help Shape employer brand: build the Working at Sift and Why I Joined programs into a real cadence, and make the engineers the protagonists of our content.
* Own speaking submissions and sponsorships, coordinated with comms.
* Treat all of it as a growth portfolio: measure each program, kill what does not convert, and double down on what does.

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 4\+ years in field marketing, growth, events, brand, or community, with real ownership of a calendar, a budget, and a number.
* Time inside a company during the stretch when it became a place people wanted to work, with a clear account of what you specifically owned.
* Proof you can make an IRL moment travel online: events you ran that became posts people actually saw, shared, and showed up because of.
* A real presence on or fluency with Twitter, especially the hard tech and defense tech corners of it.
* A track record of running a hosted format people ask to be invited to.
* A real Bay Area network in hard tech, defense tech, robotics, or autonomy.
* Equal comfort with vibe and funnel: has made things that were simply great, and has shipped work with attribution behind it, and refuses to choose between the two.
* Production instinct: comfortable directing video, photography, and editorial and getting it out the door fast.
* Operational exactness: contracts, deposits, shipping deadlines, badge scanners, vendor invoices.
* Comfort in the CRM and marketing automation stack, building your own invite lists and running your own campaigns.
* Willingness to travel: roughly one show a month in season, plus regular time in LA and periodic trips to DC.

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience marketing in NDA\-constrained environments, where much of what customers do cannot be named on a banner.
* Experience opening a new market or city for a company previously concentrated in one place.
* Existing relationships with venue, production, and experiential vendors in San Francisco.
* Experience running partner and co\-marketing motions, including shared booths and co\-hosted events.

**Location:**
-------------


This role is based in our San Francisco office at 211 Sutter Street and is in person four days a week. Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (next to LAX); expect regular travel to LA, roughly one industry event per month in season, and periodic travel to Washington, DC. We come together as a company for a full week every three months.


Salary range: $125,000 \- $175,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.


Compensation Range: $125K \- $175K
