* 5 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, and managing customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You will manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $114000 \- $163000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
* Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with Support, Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers to ensure customer success, and work with customers and Support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager, Developer Relations - Hitachi
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the boundless possibilities of AI to develop the next era of computing. In this era, GPUs, accelerated software, and AI factories become the brains of computers, robots, industrial systems, and autonomous machines.


As a Global Account Manager, Developer Relations, you will lead the technical efforts to advance integration of NVIDIA's libraries, models, and frameworks. This work will focus on Hitachi, one of our largest and most strategic industrial partners. You will partner with product teams at NVIDIA and Hitachi to encourage NVIDIA software integration into Hitachi platforms and solutions. This supports their long\-term business and technical goals. This highly visible position aligns with our product organization to deliver joint solutions that move the needle and with our enterprise go\-to\-market organization to drive mutual success. The ideal candidate brings an outstanding blend of industrial ecosystem fluency, developer advocacy, and strong technical account management experience across energy, mobility, manufacturing, digital engineering, and enterprise AI.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Drive adoption of NVIDIA software libraries, open models, SDKs, NIMs, blueprints, and frameworks across Hitachi business, product, and engineering groups.
* Partner with NVIDIA account, technical, product, and engineering teams to align integration priorities across multiple Hitachi businesses.
* Accelerate critical Hitachi workloads by incorporating the NVIDIA software stack into products, platforms, and pipelines.
* Connect NVIDIA DevTech, Solution Architecture, Developer Relations, and Product Engineering teams with Hitachi stakeholders to advance collaborative development and adoption.
* Engage executive and technical leaders across NVIDIA and Hitachi to guide integrations, resolve technical challenges, track adoption, identify new workflows, and relay field insights.
* Identify differentiated solution opportunities in Physical AI, DSX / AI Factory, Agentic AI, digital twins, edge AI, and industrial automation while fostering Hitachi needs inside NVIDIA.
* Lead multi\-functional partnership execution across product, engineering, solution architecture, GTM, marketing, ecosystem, and co\-sell teams to deliver early wins, lighthouse successes, and long\-term partnership impact.

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
* 12\+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in developer relations, product management, technical partnerships, business development, or solutions architecture.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience applying accelerated computing or AI to production workloads, including industrial AI, simulation, computer vision, edge AI, inference, agentic software, data processing, or digital twins.
* Deep understanding of industrial platform ecosystems and the software stack that runs them, including energy infrastructure, rail and mobility, manufacturing, industrial automation, digital engineering, enterprise AI, or IT services.
* Proven ability to structure and implement complex technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal and external partners across sales, legal, product, and marketing teams.
* Exceptional ability to distill complex technical concepts and articulate value propositions to audiences ranging from developers to C\-suite executives.
* Experience influencing partner product roadmaps and bringing joint solutions to market with strategic customers or ISV partners.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or PhD or equivalent experience in computing, electrical engineering, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA software libraries, frameworks, and models, including CUDA\-X, cuDSS, NIM, NeMo / Nemotron, Cosmos, Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Metropolis, DeepStream, PhysicsNeMo, Holoscan, Jetson, or IGX.
* Deep experience working at or alongside Hitachi, or any major industrial technology partners, developer communities, or technical enablement programs.
* Ability to translate developer sentiment, product requirements, and market shifts into actionable intelligence for industry strategy and product roadmap decisions.
* Domain experience in energy systems, grid modernization, AI factories, autonomous mobility, industrial digital twins, or operational technology / IT convergence.


With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best\-in\-class teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD \- 356,500 USD.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.


Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 7, 2026\.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Location:** Burlingame, CA, United States
  

**Date Posted:** Sep 3, 2026
  

**Req number:** JR16128
  

**Job Type:** Regular Full Time
  

**Pay Range:**


75000\.00 to 90000\.00

  

**Description**


**The Best Teams are Created and Maintained Here.**


**Job** **Summary**


* The Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of landscape maintenance clients, building long\-term relationships that promote client satisfaction, retention, and ancillary sales. This role is responsible for overseeing field operations.

**Duties and** **Responsibilities:**


* Identify and pursue opportunities to sell ancillary (enhancement) services to existing clients within the portfolio
* Develop accurate estimates and takeoffs for both new and existing clients as needed
* Deliver timely bid proposals and designs for enhancement projects.
* Generate referrals from existing client base and communicate leads to Business Developer
* Build and maintain strong long\-term relations with clients, focusing on all pertinent points of contact
* Conduct regular site walkthroughs with clients to ensure quality and service expectations are met
* Lead and facilitate the resolution of client concerns or issues (land and/or snow)
* Ensure timely account renewals within the assigned client portfolio
* Proactively assess and address site enhancement needs during visits
* Collaborate with the Operations Manager to ensure service delivery meets or exceeds expectations (land and/or snow)
* Schedule regular site visits with the Operations Manager for quality reviews and to ensure client expectations are met (land and/or snow)
* Support hiring, training, and coaching of field crews for the assigned portfolio
* Promote and enforce safety policies and procedures
* Ensure branch financial goals are met by maintaining acceptable gross margins for both base contract work and ancillary (enhancement) services
* Assist the Branch Manager in overall leadership of the branch to include participation in all relevant meetings
* Maintain proper account documentation and notes in the CRM system
* Monitor and maintain satisfactory accounts receivable levels (land and/or snow)
* Coordinate with the Branch Administrator to keep client records and contact information current
* Perform additional duties as assigned by the Branch Manager

**Education and** **Experience:**


* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a business\-related field, or equivalent experience in a customer\-focused service industry
* inimum 3 years of experience in customer service, management, and leadership, preferably in the landscaping industry or local marketplace.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated leadership and coaching abilities
* Ability to foster collaboration and teamwork

**Physical** **Demands/Requirements:**


* Operation of a computer and other office equipment/system, such as a laptop, cell phone, and sales and operational programs/tools
* Position is a combination of mobile and sedentary work; must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time
* Customarily and regularly spends more than half of the time working away from BrightView’s places of business, walking job sites, selling and obtaining orders or contracts for BrightView’s services
* Ability to travel by car, train, and plane
* Position needs to be able to traverse uneven grounds and walk on job sites with clients and the branch team for periods of time up to 4 hours
* Ability to maintain, in your possession at all times, required medications to address any known allergic reactions should they occur

**Work** **Environment:**


* Works both indoors and outdoors; attends branch stretch and flex 3\-4 days per week
* Field\-based position, a combination of office and customer\-facing

*BrightView Landscapes, LLC is an Equal Opportunity and E\-Verify Employer.*

*This job description is subject to change at any time*


**Compensation Pay Range:**


75000\.00 to 90000\.00


***BrightView offers a suite or health, wellness, and financial benefits to full\-time team members. Benefits offerings for full\-time team members include medical, dental, and vision insurance, ancillary and voluntary products, a 401k savings plan with employer contributions, and 6 to 9 company paid holidays per year. Employees may also be eligible to receive paid time off for vacation and/or sick leave, tuition reimbursement, and/or potential variable pay opportunities based on position and performance. A detailed benefits package will be provided during the interview process****.*


*It’s Not Just a Team. It’s One BrightView.*

jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Palo Alto
jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Education Content Marketing Lead (FTC, 12 mos)
jobs.description:
OpenAI Education is seeking an **Education Content Marketing Lead** who combines exceptional editorial and curriculum judgment with strong content\-marketing instincts, a builder's mindset, and an engineer's approach to scale. This person will create high\-quality content and the systems that move it from idea to published asset quickly and consistently.


This is a hands\-on role spanning long\-form editorial, curriculum, video, visual content, channel strategy, and content operations. The lead will turn strategic briefs and expert input into useful work for students, educators, institutional leaders, and education communities; grow the channels that reach them; and use data to improve both the content and the engine behind it.

**How This Role Makes an Impact**
---------------------------------


Education needs a coherent, measurable content engine across audiences, formats, and channels. This role turns fragmented requests and one\-off production into a prioritized portfolio, reusable workflows, dependable creative capacity, and education\-specific channels that compound over time. The goal is not simply more content, but content that earns attention, supports learning and engagement, and improves through evidence.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Build and continuously improve a scalable content operating system for intake, prioritization, resourcing, production, review, publishing, versioning, and reuse.
* Apply an engineer's mindset to map dependencies, remove bottlenecks, automate repeatable work, create modular templates and playbooks, and uphold clear quality standards.
* Maintain a single source of truth for the roadmap, editorial calendar, briefs, source material, production status, approvals, assets, and metadata.
* Produce and edit multi\-format content, including long\-form articles, blogs, case studies, web and email copy, social posts, educator stories, GIFs, images, and carousels.
* Develop practical curriculum and professional\-learning resources, including lesson plans, educator guides, AI literacy materials, decks, and train\-the\-trainer content.
* Shape video from concept through final cut by developing stories, scripting and editing content, preparing interviews, and directing production or post\-production partners.
* Own and grow education\-specific channels across social, email, websites, and blogs through clear audience strategies, editorial plans, and consistent publishing programs.
* Set ambitious growth and engagement goals; define measures of content quality and efficacy; instrument tracking; analyze performance; and use experiments to improve results.
* Turn goals and expert input into clear briefs, plans, timelines, and review paths, working with partners across Content, Customer Education, Design, Marketing, Product, Research, Policy, Safety, Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success.
* Scale production by sourcing, onboarding, and managing a flexible bench of writers, editors, curriculum developers, designers, video partners, agencies, and other vendors.

**Ideal Background**
--------------------

* Significant experience (8\+ years) in content production, content marketing, editorial leadership, curriculum development, instructional design, or creative production, ideally in education, edtech, AI, or another technical field.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent writing and editing across long\-form editorial, curriculum or professional learning, video, social, web, and visual content.
* A track record of building or materially improving content systems, workflows, templates, governance, tooling, automation, or publishing operations.
* Experience owning digital channels and using audience and performance data to set ambitious growth goals, design experiments, and deliver measurable results.
* Strong video storytelling skills, including scripting, structural editing, interview preparation, and collaboration with production and post\-production specialists.
* Ability to turn ambiguous, cross\-functional input into clear requirements and polished work while sequencing priorities and managing multiple workstreams.
* Experience sourcing and onboarding external partners, plus fluency with content\-management, digital\-asset\-management, project\-management, analytics, AI, and automation tools.

We’re always on the lookout for new talent to join us in our mission to empower adventurers of all levels. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for the wilderness and have the skills to match, we’d love to hear from you.

  


**Why Work with Trail Lust Wander?**
------------------------------------


Working at Trail Lust Wander is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to turn your passion for the outdoors into a rewarding career. Here’s what makes our company unique:


* Passion\-Driven Culture: Our team is united by a love for adventure and a commitment to inspiring others to explore the great outdoors. We value creativity, innovation, and a deep connection with nature.


* Remote Work Opportunities: We understand the importance of work\-life balance, especially for those who love to spend time in the wild. Many of our positions offer the flexibility to work remotely, allowing you to blend your professional life with your outdoor passions.


* Growth and Learning: We believe in continuous learning and personal growth. At Trail Lust Wander, you’ll have opportunities to expand your skills, take on new challenges, and grow with the company.


* Collaborative Environment: We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where every team member’s ideas are valued. Your contributions will directly impact the direction and success of our platform.

  
**How to Apply**
----------------


To apply for any of the positions listed above, please follow the specific application instructions under each job title. Make sure to tailor your application to highlight your relevant experience and passion for the outdoors.


We carefully review each application and strive to respond to all candidates as quickly as possible.


**Join Our Team**
-----------------


At Trail Lust Wander, we’re always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join our team. If you don’t see a job opening that fits your skills but still believe you can contribute to our mission, we encourage you to reach out to us.


Send your resume and a cover letter explaining how you can help us grow to administrator@traillustwander.com. We’re excited to hear from you!


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------


Trail Lust Wander is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.


  
2\. Social Media Manager (Full\-Time/Remote)


Overview:
  

Trail Lust Wander is seeking a dynamic Social Media Manager to lead our social media efforts. In this role, you’ll be responsible for managing our social media accounts, creating content, engaging with our community, and driving growth across platforms like Instagram,


Facebook, and Twitter. The ideal candidate is someone who can blend creativity with strategy to build a strong online presence for our brand.


Key Responsibilities:


* Develop and execute social media strategies to grow our audience and engagement.
* Create and curate content that aligns with our brand and appeals to our followers.
* Monitor social media trends and adapt strategies accordingly.
* Engage with our community, respond to comments, and manage interactions.

Qualifications:


* Proven experience as a social media manager or in a similar role.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms, trends, and best practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Passion for outdoor adventures and the ability to translate that passion into engaging content.

How to Apply:
  

Send your resume, a cover letter, and examples of social media accounts you’ve managed to administrator@traillustwander.com with the subject line “Social Media Manager Application.”

jobs.description:
**ABOUT SPHERE**
----------------


Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190\+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.


Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.

* **Backed by a16z and YC.** $21M Series A, 30%\+ month\-over\-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.
* **Small team, global surface area**. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office.
* **The problem keeps compounding.** Expanding into input tax, withholding, e\-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead.

  

**THE ROLE**
------------


Sphere is looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build our outbound sales engine.


You'll work directly with our Account Executives and Founder to identify the companies we should be selling to, understand why Sphere matters to them, and create opportunities with CFOs, Controllers, Tax leaders, and other senior finance executives.


This isn't a role where you'll inherit a finished playbook and spend your day running someone else's sequences. You'll be expected to prospect relentlessly, learn quickly, experiment with what works, and help us build the playbook as we go.

**This role is designed to be a path into an Account Executive position at Sphere.** You'll get exposure to the full sales cycle from day one, learn directly from our AEs and the founder, and take on more responsibility as you prove you're ready. We want to develop our next generation of AEs from within.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Build and own targeted account lists across our core markets.
* Prospect into CFOs, Controllers, Heads of Tax, and other senior finance leaders.
* Research companies to understand their business model, global footprint, and why Sphere could matter to them.
* Create pipeline through phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and creative outbound.
* Work directly with AEs on account strategy, messaging, and multithreading.
* Learn how to qualify real business problems rather than simply book meetings.
* Get exposure to discovery, demos, deal strategy, negotiation, and closing.
* Take on increasing ownership of opportunities as you develop.
* Experiment constantly with messaging, targeting, signals, and new ways to create pipeline.
* Help build the outbound playbook that future SDRs at Sphere will inherit.

  

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

* You want to build a career in B2B sales and eventually own a number.
* You're a strong communicator and comfortable starting conversations with people more senior than you.
* You're competitive, curious, and willing to put in the reps.
* You learn quickly and actively seek feedback.
* You're comfortable operating in an environment where the answer isn't always obvious.
* You take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.
* You're excited to work alongside the team in our San Francisco office five days a week.

  

**NICE TO HAVES**
-----------------

* Previous SDR experience is helpful, but not required. We're more interested in trajectory than pedigree.
* Previous outbound sales or prospecting experience.
* Experience at an early stage startup.
* Experience selling or working with Finance, Accounting, or Tax teams.
* Evidence that you've been exceptional at something competitive, whether that's sales, athletics, academics, entrepreneurship, or something else.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

*You'll thrive here if:*

* **You're a Dog.** You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: *good, that means the opportunity is ours.* Hunger beats pedigree.
* **Early stage is in your bones.** You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.
* **You own it end to end.** Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.
* **You believe speed and accuracy are both possible.** We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.
* **Being in the room is a feature, not a cost.** Five days in SF isn't a policy, it's how the work gets done. The speed and density of collaboration we need doesn't survive over video.

 *This won't be a fit if:*

* You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating
* You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)
* You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)
* Being in the room five days a week feels like a cost instead of a benefit


Compensation Range: $75K \- $140K

jobs.description:
**About Sift**
--------------


Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high\-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission\-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.  

  

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.

**About the Role**
------------------


Sift's Business Development Representatives are the front line of our enterprise sales team. You'll own a portfolio of named accounts across aerospace, defense, and industrial engineering, building relationships with the teams designing rockets, satellites, autonomous systems, and other mission\-critical hardware.


This isn't mindless outbound. Success comes from curiosity, research, and good judgment. You'll learn how complex engineering organizations buy software, identify the right technical and executive stakeholders, and secure conversations through thoughtful, personalized outreach. You'll partner closely with an Account Executive to develop account strategy, travel to industry events and customer sites, and use AI\-assisted tooling to research accounts and scale high\-quality outreach.


As one of our early GTM hires, you'll work closely with sales leadership, gain exposure to full enterprise deal cycles, and build the technical and commercial foundation to grow into an Account Executive, sales leadership, or other GTM roles as you succeed.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own a portfolio of named accounts and drive the outreach strategy for each, from first touch to qualified meeting
* Map account org structures: identify decision\-makers, champions, and technical stakeholders across engineering, procurement, and program leadership
* Prioritize accounts using signals like funding, new leadership, program announcements, and industry news
* Identify new, unnamed opportunities: map emerging markets and adjacent verticals outside your assigned accounts, and make the case for where Sift should expand next
* Run personalized, multi\-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn) tailored to the technical buyer, not generic sequences
* Partner closely with your assigned AE: align on account strategy, keep pipeline visibility current, and ensure a clean handoff once a meeting is booked (join the first call as needed, but the AE owns prep)
* Keep CRM and account records current and accurate
* Travel to industry events and customer sites when it directly supports a named account
* Use AI\-assisted tooling to synthesize account research and draft outreach efficiently

**Required Skills:**
--------------------

* 1\-4 years in a customer\-facing, high\-performance environment (B2B sales development, consulting, program or capture support, or similar)
* Strong written communication; able to write outreach that reads as specific and researched, not templated
* Comfortable owning a portfolio and prioritizing without heavy oversight
* Highly self\-motivated, hardworking, and driven, with a track record of finding creative approaches when the obvious path doesn't work
* Genuine curiosity about hard tech, aerospace, defense, or industrial engineering
* Willing to travel for events and customer visits

**Bonus Points:**
-----------------

* Experience selling into or supporting government/defense programs
* Familiarity with account mapping or capture strategy in complex, multi\-stakeholder orgs
* Experience with Clarify, Salesforce, Apollo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

**Location:**
-------------


Sift’s headquarters is in **Marina Del Rey, CA** (Next to LAX). We collaborate **in person** twice a week—on **Mondays and Thursdays**—and come together for a full week every three months. We are open to **relocating candidates to LA** or **working from our San Francisco** office for the right candidate.


Salary range: $75,000 \- $125,000 base, plus $25,000\-$50,000 bonus per year, plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
----------------

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.


Compensation Range: $75K \- $125K

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Our Company:** Originally founded in 1975, BCI has continually evolved to become a leader in the women’s fashion industry. Launching initially with CHAUS and private label lines and then expanding into a multi\-brand platform business, we have been at the forefront of market trends and the changing retail environment.


Our brands, including CeCe, Vince Camuto, Ted Baker, 1\.State and Parker, each serve unique customer demographics but are united in their commitment to quality and style. As we expand our presence, BCI remains dedicated to innovation, excellence, and women’s empowerment through fashion.

**THE ROLE:**


We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Logistics Coordinator** to join our Logistics team. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in international logistics and experience coordinating shipments from vendors/factories through final delivery.


This role is highly collaborative and requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple shipments, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously. The Logistics Coordinator will work closely with freight forwarders, overseas vendors/factories, and internal departments including Production, Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure shipments move efficiently and arrive on time.


In addition to core logistics responsibilities, this position will support our GS1 program, UCC\-128 carton labeling, cartonization, and factory coordination, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to expand their logistics expertise within the apparel industry.

**Ideal Candidate**


The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of shipments from start to finish. They should be confident communicating with vendors and logistics partners, while also being able to work effectively with multiple internal departments.


Most importantly, this person should have a strong logistics coordination foundation and be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly. Experience with GS1/UCC\-128, cartonization, and factory operations is a strong advantage, but the ability to learn and grow in these areas is equally important.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Shipment \& Logistics Management*

* Track and monitor international and domestic shipments from origin through final delivery.
* Maintain accurate shipment status updates and proactively identify potential delays or issues.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, carriers, customs brokers, 3PL warehouses, and other logistics partners.
* Follow up with vendors/factories regarding shipment readiness, booking information, ETDs, ETAs, documentation, and delivery requirements.
* Review shipping documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Communicate shipment delays, changes, and exceptions to the appropriate internal teams.
* Ensure shipments meet required delivery dates and company guidelines.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and provide regular reporting and updates to the Logistics team.

*Vendor \& Factory Coordination*

* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with overseas vendors and factories.
* Communicate directly with factories regarding shipping requirements, production readiness, carton information, and documentation.
* Work closely with vendors to resolve shipment discrepancies, delays, documentation issues, and other logistics\-related concerns.
* Ensure factories understand and follow company shipping and labeling requirements.
* Partner with Production and other teams to align factory readiness with shipping timelines.
* *Cross\-Functional Communication*
* Work closely with internal departments including Production, Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, and Logistics to ensure accurate and timely flow of information.
* Provide shipment updates and relevant information to internal stakeholders.
* Assist with resolving issues that impact customer delivery dates, inventory availability, or financial processing.
* Serve as a key point of contact between internal teams, vendors, and logistics service providers.

*GS1 / UCC\-128 Program*

* Support and maintain the company’s GS1/UCC\-128 carton labeling program.
* Coordinate with vendors/factories to ensure carton labels are created and applied according to company and customer requirements.
* Review and troubleshoot UCC\-128 label issues and work with factories to correct discrepancies.
* Assist with cartonization of goods, including carton quantities \& ensure compliance within the guidelines of the program.
* Work closely with factories to ensure cartonization and labeling information is accurate before goods ship.
* Help ensure carton information aligns with purchase orders, shipping documentation, and customer requirements.

  

**Requirements**  

* **2\+ years of experience in logistics, transportation,** supply chain, or a related field, preferably in an apparel environment.
* Strong foundation in logistics coordination and shipment tracking.
* Experience working with freight forwarders, vendors, factories, and/or carriers.
* Experience with international shipping and familiarity with import processes preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external teams.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with GS1, UCC\-128 labeling, or retail carton labeling requirements.
* Experience with cartonization, carton packing information, or factory packing compliance.
* Experience working directly with overseas apparel factories.
* Familiarity with ERP systems.

jobs.title: Catering Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============


Green Top Farms is a New York\-based food service company specializing in farm\-fresh meals for enterprise workplace dining and corporate catering. We partner with leading companies to deliver elevated daily dining and hospitality experiences, using seasonal ingredients and thoughtful operations to create consistent, high\-quality service at scale.


Our mission is to build a more sustainable and equitable food system, starting by reconnecting consumers and local farmers. We believe the results of strengthening that connection are better nutrition, tastier food, greater social justice, and reduced environmental impacts. Our menus reflect this attention to bringing nutritious, delicious food to those who need it most.

**Position Overview**
=====================


The Sales Coordinator is an entry\-level role that keeps our sales and business development engine organized and moving. You will provide the administrative backbone for an experienced sales team, handling the coordination, data, and follow\-through that let our senior sellers focus on clients and growth. You will work closely with and learn directly from our CEO and Biz Dev Manager, gaining hands\-on exposure to how enterprise dining and catering accounts are won and grown.


This is a strong fit for someone early in their career or changing careers into sales. We are looking for a candidate who is:

* Highly organized, reliable, and detail\-oriented
* Eager to learn sales and business development from the ground up
* Comfortable owning administrative work that keeps a team on track
* A clear communicator who follows through without being chased


The ideal candidate brings energy and coachability, takes ownership of the details, and wants to grow into a client\-facing sales or account role over time.

**Responsibilities**
====================

### **Sales Administration \& Coordination (35%)**

* Keep the sales process organized and running day to day.
* Prepare and format proposals, quotes, menus, and contracts for review
* Maintain the team's sales calendar and schedule client and prospect meetings
* Organize sales collateral, templates, and shared files so they are easy to find
* Enter and track sales activity and orders accurately across our systems
* Coordinate clean handoffs from sales to operations, culinary, and account management

### **CRM \& Pipeline Support (25%)**

* Keep our client and prospect data accurate and useful.
* Maintain up\-to\-date records in our CRM (HubSpot), logging calls, activities, and next steps
* Keep pipeline data clean so reporting reflects reality
* Run and format sales reports and help track team KPIs and targets
* Flag follow\-ups, renewals, and at\-risk items to the senior team

### **Client \& Prospect Support (20%)**

* Support responsive, professional communication with clients and prospects.
* Respond to inbound inquiries and route them to the right person
* Support outreach by scheduling calls, sending follow\-up materials, and confirming details
* Help coordinate tastings, sample drop\-offs, and event logistics
* Prepare menus and pricing for the sales team and answer routine client questions

### **Learning \& Development (10%)**

* Grow toward a client\-facing sales or account role.
* Shadow the CEO and Biz Dev Manager on calls, meetings, and pitches
* Take notes, capture action items, and complete follow\-ups
* Build product, menu, and market knowledge over time

### **Cross\-Functional \& General Support (10%)**

* Support the broader team as priorities require.
* Coordinate with operations, culinary, and account management on shared work
* Assist with catering and event support as needed
* Take on additional administrative duties that help the sales team succeed

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 0 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent transferable experience from another field
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable using Google Workspace or Microsoft Office
* Genuine eagerness to learn sales and business development
* A commitment to personal accountability and continuous learning
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment

**Preferred Qualifications**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Interest in food service, hospitality, or sustainability
* Familiarity with a CRM platform (HubSpot preferred)
* Experience with project management software (Asana preferred)
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

**Key Competencies**
----------------------------------------------------------------
* Organization and follow\-through
* Clear and proactive communication
* Eagerness to learn and coachability
* Reliability and ownership
* Cross\-functional collaboration

Role Details

Barry’s is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity, and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. Applicants with disabilities who need assistance with the application process may be entitled to a reasonable accommodation in accordance with applicable law. If you need assistance in completing this application or with the application process because of a disability, please contact the People and Culture Department (people@barrys.com).  

Barry’s is the Best Workout in the WorldTM®. Founded in West Hollywood in 1998, it’s the original strength and cardio interval fitness experience that provides an immersive, high\-intensity, one\-hour workout that’s as effective as it is fun. Our fitness classes alternate between working out with weights and running on a treadmill. Each day focuses on a different muscle group in order to achieve real results and to prevent injuries. Our program is designed to tone muscle and maximize fat loss, while spiking the metabolism for up to 48 hours following the class.  

Please be aware that smoking is prohibited in all indoor areas of Barry’s studios and corporate offices. **About the role**
Barry's grows one first class at a time. Someone walks in, finds their spot in the Red Room, and leaves knowing they'll be back. Your job is to create as many of those first classes as possible.


You'll own local event marketing across the New York market\- in\-studio community nights and bring\-a\-friend classes, plus out\-of\-studio pop\-ups, run clubs, and partnerships with local brands, employers, and buildings. Every event is measured the same way: how many people took their first class because of it, and how many came back.

**What you'll do**  

* Own the NYC event calendar across all studios, building a repeatable cadence of first\-timer programming with Studio Managers and instructors, with a particular emphasis on New Studios
* Design and execute out\-of\-studio activations and pop\-ups in high\-density neighborhoods and at local moments
* Build a pipeline of local partnerships\- brands, hospitality, retail, run clubs, corporate and residential buildings\- that puts Barry's in front of qualified new audiences
* Grow an NYC ambassador program and equip instructors to bring their networks in
* Set targets and report on first\-timer acquisition, cost per first\-timer, and first\-to\-second\-visit conversion; manage the local budget and event P\&L


Event Execution

* This role is on the ground, not just on the calendar. You're personally at the events you build, and you own getting everything there and back in one piece.
* Physically attend and run every activation you own\- in\-studio and off\-site\- as the on\-site lead, not remotely managed
* Source, prep, and transport event materials\- signage, sampling product, swag, tech, tables\- to and from studios and off\-site venues, using your own vehicle or approved local transport
* Lead setup and breakdown at each activation yourself, or delegate and directly brief Studio Managers, instructors, or ambassadors when you're covering multiple sites in the same window
* Own day\-of logistics with venues, building management, and vendors\- load\-in windows, storage, permitting, and on\-the\-fly troubleshooting when plans change

**Qualifications**  

* 4\+ years in community, field, or event marketing\- ideally fitness, wellness, hospitality, or a consumer brand with physical locations
* A track record of events tied to hard acquisition numbers, not just attendance
* Deep familiarity with New York and existing local relationships you can activate
* Strong project management and comfort with data
* Willingness to be hands\-on and in studio
* Reliable local transportation and the ability to lift and haul event materials\- this is a physical, on\-your\-feet role across multiple sites in a single day
  

**The pay range for this role is:**  

70,000 \- 75,000 USD per year(New York)

**About The Role**



PEI Group has an exciting opportunity for an Event Coordinator to join the Event Operations team based in New York, reporting into the Senior Event Manager \- US. The successful candidate will be tasked with supporting the Event Operations team in all aspects of event execution including pre\-event preparation, onsite delivery and post\-event reporting as well as supporting Event Producers with speaker logistics for PEI’s US portfolio of conferences and events throughout the year.


**Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with Conference Producers to manage speaker deliverables related to each event portfolio

* Update speaker information and agendas to corresponding event websites, apps and agenda materials
* Add speakers into CRM database for registration as well as compile and maintain accuracy of speaker records
* Prepare speaker holding slides and manage all PowerPoint presentations for each event
* Coordinate panel prep calls up to six weeks prior to event start date

Work on projects simultaneously while adhering to event timelines  
* 

**Event Management**


* Provide logistical support to the PEI Group events team to ensure effective and successful planning and delivery of events
* Provide onsite support including setup, registration and speaker coordination (NYC and nationally)

* Build, launch and manage event apps and portals
* Assist with the venue and vendor sourcing and planning of smaller ancillary events
* Assist Event Managers with briefing in signage to the design team and proofing digital signage as needed

PEI1

* Consistent follow\-up and follow\-through, with the ability to navigate competing schedules and manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* A positive, problem\-solving attitude

* Thrives in a team environment
* Communicate clearly and effectively and an exceptional eye for detail
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook

**About Us**

PEI sits at the centre of one of the most dynamic industries in global finance. Our 500\+ team spans Europe, APAC and the Americas – researchers, journalists, data scientists, product engineers, events professionals, marketers and commercial specialists – all working to give private markets professionals the intelligence edge they need.  

  

Central to everything we do is our people. We’ve built a culture where talent grows, careers are built with intention, and everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow, and make their mark.

jobs.title: Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About On Board Experiential (OBE)**



OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture\-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.



We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.



The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly\-but\-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.



We show up for each other — in open conversations that heal, inspire, and bring us closer. We want to hear about your lived experiences, your unconventional ideas, and the perspectives only you can bring. Being unapologetically yourself isn't just welcome here. It's part of the job.


**Summary of Position**



The Account Coordinator is an integral part of the team responsible for the successful management, support, and production of our experiential programs. Reporting to a senior Account team member, this person performs essential coordination duties across the planning, development, activation, and wrap\-up stages of both client programs and internal agency initiatives.



For this entry\-level role, we are looking for a enthusiastic professional with a strong passion for lifestyle brands spanning restaurants, dining culture, travel \& hospitality, retail pop\-ups, and brand sponsorships. The Account Coordinator helps ensure the highest quality of service across client deliverables, keeping projects organized and executed with professionalism, accuracy, and timeliness.


**Essential Job Functions**


* **Project \& Team Administration:** Prepare client\-facing and internal materials, status documents, meeting agendas, and weekly recaps.
* **Lifestyle \& Sponsorship Research:** Assist with research and audit decks covering cultural trends, competitive lifestyle campaigns, venue scouting (restaurants, hotels, retail spaces), and potential brand sponsorship opportunities.
* **Deliverable Tracking:** Support the tracking of timelines and deliverables across cross\-functional teams (Production, Creative, Strategy, Tech), keeping core project management trackers updated in real time.
* **Meeting Facilitation \& Action Items:** Participate in weekly internal and client status meetings, capturing detailed notes, action items, and next steps for prompt distribution.
* **Pre\-Production Support:** Ensure assigned areas of program planning—such as vendor outreach, retail/merchandise sourcing, restaurant reservation coordination, and sample tracking—are completed on schedule.
* **Onsite Event Execution:** Assist with ground\-level logistics, sponsor activation booths, VIP hospitality check\-ins, retail display setups, and brand ambassador coordination during live event executions.
* **Post\-Event Wrap\-Up:** Participate in event debriefs, gathering photo/video assets to build client recap decks and compile performance metrics for KPI reporting.
* **Agency Culture \& Initiatives:** Join or lead internal agency committees, cultural task forces, and department offsite planning.


**Desired Skills and Experiences**


**Education \& Experience**


* **BA/BS** in marketing, business administration, hospitality, communications, or a related field.
* **Experience** in marketing, promotions, hospitality, or events (including hands\-on, onsite event execution experience). Experiential marketing agency experience is a plus.
* **Demonstrated Interest in Lifestyle Culture:** A strong passion for and baseline understanding of lifestyle categories, including food \& dining trends, hotel/travel experiences, retail activations, and sports or cultural sponsorships.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with internal teams, venue partners, and clients.
* **Detail \& Organization:** Exceptional organizational skills, high accuracy, and strong attention to detail when managing calendars, spreadsheets, and run\-of\-shows.
* **Multitasking:** Ability to navigate competing priorities and tight deadlines with agility in a fast\-paced agency environment.
* **Collaborative Mindset:** A proactive team player who works well independently and collaboratively within cross\-functional groups.


**Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* **Cultural \& Digital Pulse:** Up\-to\-date knowledge of social media trends, viral pop\-culture moments, lifestyle influencers, and emerging retail/dining concepts.
* **Brand Integrity:** Basic understanding of brand management standards, ensuring client brand guidelines are consistently upheld across event collateral, sponsor signage, and onsite environments.
* **Relationship Building:** Ability to connect with clients, vendors, and team members authentically while respecting diverse perspectives.
* **Creative Curiosity:** Willingness to bring fresh, creative ideas to brainstorms and extend beyond basic assignments to drive innovation.


**Other Qualities and Requirements**


* **Natural Curiosity:** A drive to constantly learn and explore emerging trends across travel, dining, retail, and experiential marketing.
* **Schedule Flexibility:** High energy and willingness to work non\-traditional hours (including evenings and weekends as event schedules demand).
* **Physical Capability:** Ability to lift up to 25 pounds

jobs.title: AI Operations & Executive Assistant – Speech Data & Sound
jobs.description:
**About Buttons Sound**

Buttons Sound is a New York sound production company with approximately **40 years of experience evolving with—and helping advance—changes in entertainment, media and audio technology.**

Our history spans television, film, advertising, voice recording and audio post\-production, including helping launch **Pokémon in the U.S. with Episodes 1–52**.

Today, we are bringing that same spirit of innovation into the rapidly growing world of **AI Speech Dataset production**, developing new technology and production workflows for capturing, managing, verifying and delivering high\-quality human speech data for artificial intelligence.

**40 years of sound innovation brought us here.** 

**Now we're building what's next.**

We're looking for someone who wants the opportunity to grow with us and help build this next chapter of Buttons Sound.

**About the Role**

Buttons Sound is seeking a smart, dependable and highly organized **AI Operations \& Executive Assistant** to support our growing **AI Speech Dataset production and sound business**, proprietary AI speech\-data production platform, and company leadership. This is a unique opportunity for someone interested in **AI, speech datasets, sound, technology and business operations** who wants to learn and grow with an established company expanding into an exciting new area.

You do **not** need to be a programmer or recording engineer.

We are more interested in finding someone who is intelligent, detail\-oriented, comfortable with technology, learns quickly, takes responsibility and has a strong **CAN DO attitude**.

The position combines AI Speech Dataset operations, sound\-production support, project coordination, research, sound business\-development support, executive assistance and recording\-facility operations.

Because our projects and priorities change, we're looking for someone who enjoys variety and can shift effectively between responsibilities while staying organized and productive.

**What You'll Do**

Responsibilities will vary depending on active projects and company priorities and may include:

* Set up and organize AI Speech Dataset projects
* Organize client scripts, specifications, files and production requirements
* Use our proprietary production platform to import, review and validate project information
* Work with spreadsheets, structured data and production tracking systems
* Prepare materials for speech\-data recording sessions
* Track recordings, completed files, pickups and production issues
* Review filenames, file counts, metadata and client delivery requirements
* Assist with speech\-data quality control and dataset verification
* Prepare project documentation and dataset delivery manifests
* Help test and improve our AI Speech Dataset production workflows and procedures
* Research AI, speech\-data, sound and technology companies and prospective clients
* Build and maintain prospect and CRM information
* Research RFPs and potential sound and AI business opportunities
* Assist with outreach preparation and client follow\-up
* Support Buttons Sound's broader sound business\-development activities
* Help maintain executive priority lists, project information and action items
* Assist with scheduling, research, correspondence and special projects
* Support recording\-booth readiness and participant logistics when needed
* Perform basic troubleshooting and escalate technical problems appropriately
* Assist with other operational and executive priorities as the company grows

When active production requires less attention, available time will be directed toward

· AI workflow testing,

· sound business development,

· prospect research,

· CRM development, documentation,

· outreach preparation and executive\-support projects.

The goal is to make every working hour productive while giving the right person exposure to many different aspects of operating and growing a sound and AI Speech Dataset business.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who is:

* Extremely dependable and organized
* Detail\-oriented and accurate
* Comfortable with computers and spreadsheets
* Able to learn new software quickly
* A strong written communicator
* Comfortable following detailed procedures
* Able to work independently
* Comfortable switching between different types of assignments
* Curious about AI, speech technology, sound and data
* Resourceful when researching information or solving problems
* Willing to identify and report mistakes or problems rather than hide them
* Professional and comfortable communicating with clients and team members
* Positive, proactive and solution\-oriented
* Someone who sees something that needs to be done and takes initiative
* Someone with a genuine **CAN DO attitude**

Experience with Excel, Google Sheets, CRM systems, project\-management software, audio production, AI or data projects is helpful but not required.

Programming or Python experience is not required.

Audio\-engineering experience is not required.

A specific AI background is not required.

Training in our proprietary AI Speech Dataset production workflow will be provided.

We value character, aptitude, reliability and willingness to learn over specific credentials.

Schedule \& Compensation

* Part\-time position
* Approximately 28–32 hours per week initially
* $17–$20 per hour, depending on experience and capabilities
* Primarily an on\-site New York City position
* Some schedule flexibility may be required during active production projects

**Growth Opportunity**

Buttons Sound is building a specialized operational team supporting our growing AI Speech Dataset production and sound business.

For someone who demonstrates reliability, initiative and the ability to master our workflow, this position has the potential to develop into:

**AI Operations Assistant → AI Operations Associate → AI Production Coordinator → AI Production Manager**

jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.



Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.



Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.



At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  


**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

  

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.



By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.



This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota\-carrying seller. You'll partner cross\-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add\-on SKUs, and build deep, long\-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.



Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market\-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.


**This is a hybrid role based in NYC.**


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own NRR: Manage the full post\-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high\-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long\-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi\-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision\-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
* Sell Competitively: Position Aircall's value head\-to\-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer's unique business needs.
* Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
* Manage Pipeline \& Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data\-driven NRR forecasting.
* Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall's product roadmap and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

  


### **Qualifications:**


* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer\-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
* Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
* Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
* Analytical, detail\-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
* Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long\-term value through partnership.
* Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next\-generation AI\-powered communications platform.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

We're a full\-service creative shop born out of ATTN:'s purpose\-driven mission to bring attention to the things that matter. We exist to build brands for the attention era. We accelerate growth for brands, putting them at the center of culture so they become the center of attention. We are a diverse group of entrepreneurial spirits, creative minds and makers and we're lucky enough to work with some of the world's most innovative brands and culturally connected brands.
