jobs.title: Production Assistant – Ice Cream Production
jobs.description:
**Production Assistant – Ice Cream Production**

**Date Posted:** September 3, 2026

**Pay:** $18\.00 – $24\.00 per hour, based on experience

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Work Location:** In person — Wilmette, IL

**About Us**

Homer's Ice Cream has been crafting small\-batch, super\-premium ice cream since 1935\. We serve customers through our retail shop and supply handcrafted ice cream to wholesale partners across the region. Our company is built on tradition, quality, and craftsmanship. We are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things right and wants to grow their skills in a hands\-on food production environment.

**Position Summary**

As our retail and wholesale volume continues to grow, we're adding a Production Assistant to support our Production Manager in daily ice cream production. This is a newly created position, not a replacement of any existing role — an active, floor\-based job, not a desk position. You'll work directly in production — prepping ingredients, packaging finished product, keeping the production area clean and organized, and learning our processes from the ground up.

This role is a growth opportunity: as you build experience and consistency, you'll cross\-train on batch freezing and recipe execution with the goal of becoming our second backup Ice Cream Maker — extra coverage during busy stretches, planned time off, or whenever the team needs another set of trained hands. No prior ice cream–making experience is required to start, just a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Support**

* Prepare and weigh ingredients, inclusions, and flavor bases for the Production Manager
* Assist with loading, running, and cleaning batch freezers and production equipment under supervision
* Fill and package finished product into pints, quarts, and 3\-gallon tubs
* Help monitor batch consistency, texture, and quality alongside the Production Manager

**Packaging, Labeling \& Fulfillment**

* Accurately label and organize product for retail and wholesale orders
* Move finished product to walk\-in freezers and maintain organized freezer storage
* Support pulling and staging wholesale orders for delivery

**Cleaning \& Sanitation**

* Follow food safety and sanitation standards at all times
* Clean and sanitize equipment, tools, and production surfaces between batches and at shift end
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe production environment
* Assist with proper equipment maintenance and cleaning procedures

**Growth \& Cross\-Training**

* Learn established recipes and standard procedures alongside the Production Manager
* Progressively take on more hands\-on batch\-freezing responsibility as skills develop
* Build toward serving as a second backup Ice Cream Maker, providing extra production coverage alongside the Production Manager

**Qualifications**

* No prior ice cream production experience required — training provided
* Experience in a kitchen, food production, or manufacturing setting is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions and recipes precisely
* Comfortable working in a hands\-on, physical food production setting
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work in temperature\-controlled/walk\-in freezer environments
* Ability to work early mornings or production\-based schedules, including some weekends as needed
* Dependable, punctual, and eager to grow with the company

**Working Conditions**

* Food manufacturing / production environment
* Standing for extended periods
* Exposure to food processing equipment and temperature\-controlled environments, including walk\-in freezers
* May require early morning shifts, and occasional evenings or weekends depending on production needs

**Pay**

$18\.00 – $24\.00 per hour, based on experience

**Benefits**

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* On\-the\-job training
* Opportunities for advancement
* Professional development assistance

**To Apply**

Please include a short note describing any experience you have with kitchens, food production, or manufacturing environments — no ice cream experience necessary.

new_jobs.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings
  
We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem\-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out\-of\-the\-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.
  
  

As an ESOP, each of our employee\-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people\-first culture and diverse portfolio of world\-class facilities.
  
  

It's What We Do
  
We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high\-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission\-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.
  
  

It's How We're Different
  
We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee\-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream\-up innovative solutions for our clients industry\-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t\_uJ\-A?si\=oSMy5zQeUcb\_faE3
  
  

Position Summary
  
Project Coordinators support Project Managers in organizing and executing projects by managing schedules, deliverables, documentation, and communication. While not responsible for leading projects, they are expected to develop a project management mindset—actively learning how projects are structured, tracked, and delivered. This role serves as an entry point into project management while building foundational knowledge of engineering design, construction practices, and project delivery processes.
  
.
  
  

Essential Job Functions \& Accountabilities
  
Project Management
  
* Supports project execution and coordination with increasing independence under the direction of the Project Manager.

new_jobs.description:
**Salary Range: $24\.33\-$35\.11 per hour**


**SUMMARY**



The Los Angeles County Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH)consolidates our countywide response to homelessness. The driving force behind HSH is increasing accountability and transparency, improving care for people experiencing or at risk of homelessness, and streamlining collaboration with partners including services providers, the County’s 88 cities, and unincorporated areas to deliver high\-quality, life\-saving care. Staff schedules are based on business need and may include the option of a hybrid work schedule where employees work remotely and from the office.



The Homeless Prevention Unit (HPU) is a collaborative effort between HSH, California Policy Lab (CPL) and the Department of Mental Health (DMH). The HPU proactively identifies individuals who are most at risk of homelessness through predictive analytics and provides them with flexible, early interventions to resolve issues that might lead to loss of their housing. HPU is expanding to serve young adults between the ages of 18\-24 in need of proactive homelessness prevention resources. The HPU has significant interactions with several County departments to address challenges navigating service systems and/or to connect or re\-connect individuals to services to ensure housing stability; therefore, the ideal candidate will be knowledgeable in mainstream and specific programs and services tailored to young people at risk of or experiencing homelessness while being flexible to meet the changing needs and demands of the program and this population.



The Medical Case Worker II (Outreach Coordinator) position will perform full\-time proactive outreach for the HPU and will report to the Outreach Program Manager. Working closely with the TAY Case Managers and other HPU supporting staff, this position will be responsible for outreaching to and engaging with prospective clients who are identified as at high risk of experiencing homelessness. The Medical Case Worker II will conduct outreach, gather consents from prospective clients and facilitate warm hand\-offs for long\-term care to HPU Case Managers.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


**Outreach**

* Provides outreach and engagement services to HPU clients in collaboration with Outreach Program Manager and other HPU staff.
* Oversees the coordination of new client assignments, intake, and care coordination with case managers, ensuring a smooth transition from intake process to assessment and enrollment.
* Collaborates with case managers, as needed, by identifying linkages, immediate needs gathering and submitting necessary documentation from clients pre\-enrollment.
* Triages and assesses HPU clients to determine their immediate safety needs as well as appropriate population.
* Reviews DMH and Department of Homeless Services and Housing (HSH) medical records/databases to determine service history and contact information and coordinate with current service providers as appropriate.
* Identifies potential immediate interventions for early\-stage HPU clients and link them to the resources needed to ensure housing retention including sources of income, short term rental assistance and assistance with arrears or utilities as well as medical, mental health and substance use providers as appropriate and food, clothing, transportation and vocational resources.
* Provides HPU clients with crisis intervention support as needed including assisting clients to access emergency and crisis stabilization services such as the DMH Psychiatric Mobile Response Team (PMRT), mental health urgent care services, medical and/or substance use disorder services.
* Collaborates with HPU clients and family members (when appropriate) to develop and amend treatment plan goals.


**Data \& Project Management**


* Manages and maintains monthly outreach data entry, documentation, and client reassignments.
* Supports Outreach Program manager in the planning of monthly outreach and new client engagement for Case Manager teams work with single adults, families and Transitional Aged Youth (TAY).
* Completes and submits all required documentation in a timely manner to ensure client progress is monitored and outcomes collected.
* Collaborates and coordinates with HPU management to identify and discuss programmatic and data needs as well as obtain consultation as needed on the appropriate level of interventions/services needed to support clients.
* Other duties as assigned.


**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**



One year of experience as a Medical Case Worker I \- OR \- A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and one year of professional casework experience interviewing, counseling, and assisting patients/clients with social problems.


**Certificates/Licenses/Clearances**


* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job\-related essential functions.
* Successful clearance of the Live Scan process with the County of Los Angeles.
* Health clearance required.


**Other Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities**


* Knowledgeable of community, mental health, and mainstream systems and the variety of programs offered by each to assist those most at risk of experiencing homelessness.
* Highly motivated self\-starter, with proven ability to develop creative solutions.
* Ability to coordinate projects and competing priorities in a high\-pressure, face paced and time sensitive environment.
* Ability to interact and work closely with a diverse clientele.
* Demonstrated experience interviewing clients, individuals, and families to collect data to determine what services are needed.
* Demonstrated experience in linking clients, individuals, and families to specific healthcare, mental health and community\-based programs.
* Knowledge of evidence\-based practices such as trauma informed care, motivational interviewing, de\-escalation and cognitive behavioral interventions.

Spotlight is not just a place to execute campaigns—it’s a blank canvas where ambitious people can build real leverage, take on increasing responsibility, and grow into senior operators quickly. Our culture is high\-performing, entrepreneurial, and unapologetically ambitious.


Join us, and you’ll have the trust, resources, and runway to redefine what’s possible for the world’s leading brands.

  

### **Role Overview**


We're looking for an **Account Manager** **based in Los Angeles**. This will be a **remote role** but due to our client needs you need to be based in Los Angeles.
  

  

You’ll be the execution engine for TikTok Shop accounts, working directly under a Senior Account Manager. You’ll help translate strategy into action, keep projects moving, maintain shop health, and deliver consistent, high\-quality execution across teams.


This is a **learn\-by\-doing role** designed for high\-agency operators who want to grow fast. Early on, you’ll focus on execution and account operations. As you demonstrate judgment, reliability, and ownership, your scope will expand into growth initiatives, client leadership, and strategy\-**with a clear path to Senior Account Manager typically within 6–12 months** for strong performers.

  

### **What You’ll Do**


Client Operations \& Communication

* Run the account operating rhythm: prep agendas, take notes, track action items, and send crisp recaps for WBRs/MBRs/QBRs.
* Build and maintain 30\-60\-90 day plans for each client; update owners, timelines, and success metrics weekly.
* Draft client updates and deck slides; translate performance data into clear narratives and concrete next steps.
* Manage tickets and issues, chase dependencies, and keep all stakeholders aligned and on timeline.


TikTok Shop Execution \& Health

* Own day\-to\-day Seller Center hygiene: PDP checks (titles, attributes, images), catalog updates, and compliance follow\-ups.
* Monitor and report account\-health metrics (e.g., Late Dispatch Rate, Valid Tracking Rate, cancellations/refunds) and flag risks early.
* Launch and coordinate promotions (bundles, coupons, seasonal events) with Content and Media teams.
* Support troubleshooting for approvals or policy issues by organizing evidence, timelines, and escalation documentation.


Cross\-Functional Orchestration (No Content Creation)

* Write airtight briefs for Content and Creative teams; track revisions against SLAs and quality bars.
* Partner with Media and Analytics on dashboards, UTM hygiene, and weekly performance readouts (GMV, CTR, CVR, AOV, refunds).
* Coordinate with Ops and Logistics on fulfillment readiness and customer experience status.


Data, QA, and Process

* Maintain source\-of\-truth documentation in Notion: trackers, risk logs, promo calendars, and asset libraries.
* Perform QA checks before delivery (accuracy, links, pricing, promo eligibility, compliance).
* Contribute to and improve playbooks and SOPs; capture lessons learned in retros to help the team move faster over time.

### **What You’ll Learn \& Growth Trajectory**

* Shadow your Senior AM on strategy development, escalations, negotiations, and QBR storytelling.
* Gradually take point on client calls, scope changes, and mini\-initiatives (e.g., a seasonal promo or creator activation).
* Expand from execution ownership strategy as you consistently hit scorecard targets.
* **Clear, merit\-based path to Senior Account Manager**, with increasing responsibility, influence, and compensation as your scope grows.

### **Success Metrics**

* **Delivery reliability:** On\-time/on\-brief execution; rework rate trending down.
* **Communication quality:** Clear recaps, fast response times, and strong stakeholder CSAT.

* You have a strong familiarity with **beauty and cosmetic brands**.
* You’re a strategic thinker who wants to learn through hands\-on execution.
* You have high agency and enjoy taking ownership without needing constant direction.
* You’re a checklist sniper who loves moving complex projects from “idea” to “done.”
* You write crisp, client\-ready updates and can turn metrics into simple stories with clear actions.
* You’re TikTok\-native and curious about how TikTok Shop mechanics drive conversion.
* You get energy from organizing chaos—briefs, timelines, QA, and follow\-through are your happy place.
* You have a builder mindset: you document, templatize, and leave systems better than you found them.
* You actively seek feedback and want to grow into a Senior AM quickly.

### **What You Bring (Requirements)**

* 1–7\+ years in e\-commerce, marketplaces, digital marketing, consulting, or client\-facing operations (agency experience a plus).
* Strong project management skills: task tracking, timelines, stakeholder coordination.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel; comfort working with dashboards and basic analysis (filters, pivots, lookups).
* Excellent written and verbal communication with a strong service mindset.
* Familiarity with TikTok as a consumer platform and eagerness to master TikTok Shop (we’ll train you on our playbooks).

**About Varda**
---------------



Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in\-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W\-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in\-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C\-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**



From life\-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.



Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. new_jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager, ASCS - Amazon Freight
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Freight, a key pillar within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Account Management team. This is a customer facing relationship management role within our commercial organization. You will serve as the primary operational partner for Amazon Freight's largest enterprise shippers, owning the customer relationship, identifying systemic issues that impact their experience, and coordinating cross functional teams to drive resolution.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the enterprise customer operational relationship across all freight modes (TL, IMDL, LTL), serving as the single threaded point of contact for your accounts' operational points of contact
* Identify systemic operational defects impacting your accounts using performance dashboards and customer feedback. Quantify the problem in dollars, loads, and retention risk
* Coordinate cross functional teams to resolution: gather customer insights, understand requirements, bring the right internal teams together, align on the path forward, and ensure we deliver. You don't solve problems alone but you own making sure they get solved
* Own the customer facing performance narrative. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, produce recovery plans during performance degradation, and proactively communicate progress on open issues with timelines and measurable targets
* Own escalation communication to customer executives when something goes wrong: what's happening, what we're doing about it, and how we're tracking toward resolution
* Own internal reporting, including MBRs, account bridges, and leading inspection mechanisms for your accounts. Report out on performance metrics, cost inputs, and customer KPIs
* Influence customer operations to drive optimal inputs that lower our costs. Define what good looks like, measure it, and partner with customers to change how they operate
* Activate structured recovery programs before the customer escalates

  

A day in the life  

Your day starts with account health dashboards, spotting a detention\-charge trend at one customer's facilities and digging into its cause. By midmorning you're briefing a customer's regional transportation director on performance, then rallying ops and pricing partners on a structural issue hitting multiple facilities. After lunch you build your MBR narrative, quantifying your team's impact and open items. Later you lead a working session with operations and product on a fix to prevent recurring defects, then close by updating a customer VP on a two\-week escalation, showing progress against committed targets.  

  

About the team  

The Enterprise Customer Success team is newly formed within Amazon Freight's commercial organization. This team serves as the single threaded relationship owner for our largest customers' operational points of contact. We exist to ensure that every enterprise shipper on our platform experiences the service level we committed to, and when they don't, we coordinate the teams that fix it.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience positioning and selling innovative solutions to new and existing customers and market segments
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of B2B or enterprise sales with a focus on hunting new business experience
* Knowledge of procurement and source to pay processes and solutions or equivalent experience
* Experience identifying trends and needs to improve an already closed large\-scale technology deal

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a leading assisted reproductive technology (ART) fertility clinic located in Torrance, CA, dedicated to helping individuals and couples build their families. We provide world\-class fertility care including IVF, egg freezing, genetic testing, and comprehensive reproductive health services. We are currently seeking a motivated, relationship\-driven Field Marketing Representative to join our team and expand our referral network with OB/GYN clinics, women‘s health providers, and community healthcare partners in the Greater Los Angeles area.

**Position Overview**

This is a front\-line, field\-based role. You will be the “face” of our clinic to referring OB/GYN practices, primary care physicians, and other healthcare providers. Your primary mission is to build and nurture strong referral relationships, educate community physicians about our services and success rates, and drive patient referrals to our clinic. This role requires frequent in\-person visits to OB/GYN clinics and medical offices throughout the Torrance and surrounding South Bay / LA area.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct regular in\-person visits to OB/GYN clinics, women’s health practices, and primary care offices in your assigned territory
* Build and maintain strong, trusting relationships with physicians, nurse practitioners, and medical office staff
* Educate referring providers on our fertility services, treatment options, success rates, and referral pathways
* Distribute promotional materials and keep referring offices updated on new services, physician availability, and clinic events
* Identify and develop new referral sources, including community health organizations, advocacy groups, and corporate wellness programs
* Represent the clinic at community events, health fairs, and medical conferences
* Track all partner interactions, referral volumes, and outreach activities in CRM system
* Gather market intelligence on competitor activities and physician needs, and provide feedback to the marketing and clinical teams
* Coordinate and host lunch\-and\-learns, educational presentations, and open\-house events for medical professionals

**Qualifications**

* Associate’s or Bachelor‘s degree in Marketing, Business, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 1–3 years of experience in field sales, medical sales, pharmaceutical sales, or healthcare business development preferred
* Experience in fertility, OB/GYN, women’s health, or reproductive medicine is a strong plus
* Existing relationships with OB/GYN practices or physicians in the South Bay / Los Angeles area is highly desirable
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Self\-motivated with strong time management skills and ability to work independently in the field
* Comfortable with cold outreach and building relationships from the ground up
* Valid driver‘s license and reliable transportation (mileage reimbursement provided)
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM software
* Bilingual (English/Spanish or English/Mandarin/Cantonese) is a plus, but not required

Pay: From $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Travel reimbursement
* Vision insurance

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Spectrum Brand Marketing Solutions is seeking a highly organized, customer\-focused Client Success Specialist to serve as a primary point of contact for clients and support the successful execution of their branded merchandise, printing, promotional products, kitting, fulfillment, and marketing projects.

This role is responsible for managing client requests from initial inquiry through order completion, ensuring clear and timely communication, accurate order entry, competitive sourcing, proposal development, and coordination with internal teams and vendors. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, solutions\-focused, and comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

While the primary focus is client service and order management, this position will also support business development through client outreach, identifying additional opportunities, and helping grow existing client relationships.

**Duties**

Client Service \& Relationship Management

* Serve as a primary day\-to\-day contact for assigned clients and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication and exceptional customer service.
* Understand client needs, timelines, budgets, and project requirements and provide appropriate solutions.
* Keep clients informed throughout the order and production process, including timelines, approvals, inventory, shipping, and delivery.
* Resolve client questions or issues and coordinate internally to ensure timely solutions.
* Maintain accurate client and project information.

Order Management \& Entry

* Receive and review client orders, requests, and project specifications.
* Enter orders accurately into internal systems and ensure all required information is captured.
* Coordinate order approvals, artwork, inventory, production, kitting, fulfillment, and shipping requirements.
* Monitor orders from initial entry through completion and proactively communicate any changes or potential delays.
* Track multiple orders and projects simultaneously while meeting established deadlines.
* Coordinate with Operations, Production, Creative, Sales, and other internal teams to ensure successful execution.
* Sourcing \& Product Research
* Source promotional products, branded merchandise, printing, packaging, and other client\-requested items.
* Research product availability, pricing, minimum quantities, production timelines, and shipping requirements.
* Work with vendors to obtain pricing, samples, product information, and production timelines.
* Identify cost\-effective alternatives and solutions when requested products are unavailable or do not meet budget or timeline requirements.
* Maintain knowledge of current promotional products, printing capabilities, packaging solutions, and fulfillment services.

Proposals, Quotes \& Pricing

* Prepare client proposals, quotes, estimates, and pricing recommendations based on project requirements.
* Obtain and compare vendor pricing to ensure competitive and accurate client pricing.
* Calculate product, production, kitting, fulfillment, storage, shipping, and other applicable costs.
* Clearly communicate pricing, timelines, assumptions, and project details to clients.
* Follow up on proposals and quotes to help convert opportunities into orders.

Business Development \& Client Outreach

* Conduct proactive outreach to existing and prospective clients to identify new opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for additional products, services, and solutions based on client needs and previous projects.
* Follow up with clients regarding proposals, past projects, upcoming events, and potential new initiatives.
* Support account growth through cross\-selling and upselling Spectrum's products and services.
* Assist with prospecting and new\-business outreach as needed.
* Maintain and develop a pipeline of potential client opportunities.

Project Coordination

* Coordinate projects involving branded merchandise, printing, promotional products, corporate gifting, kitting, fulfillment, inventory, and shipping.
* Establish and monitor project timelines and key milestones.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal departments to ensure projects remain on schedule.
* Track inventory and identify potential shortages or replenishment requirements.
* Assist with coordinating nationwide shipping and fulfillment requirements.
* Ensure projects are completed accurately, on time, and according to client expectations.

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in customer service, account management, client success, sales support, order management, or related field.
* Experience in printing, promotional products, branded merchandise, marketing services, or fulfillment is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

In this era, GPUs, accelerated software, and AI factories become the brains of computers, robots, industrial systems, and autonomous machines.


As a Global Account Manager, Developer Relations, you will lead the technical efforts to advance integration of NVIDIA's libraries, models, and frameworks. This highly visible position aligns with our product organization to deliver joint solutions that move the needle and with our enterprise go\-to\-market organization to drive mutual success. * Engage executive and technical leaders across NVIDIA and Hitachi to guide integrations, resolve technical challenges, track adoption, identify new workflows, and relay field insights.

* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience applying accelerated computing or AI to production workloads, including industrial AI, simulation, computer vision, edge AI, inference, agentic software, data processing, or digital twins.

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT SPHERE**
----------------


Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190\+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.


Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.

* **Backed by a16z and YC.** $21M Series A, 30%\+ month\-over\-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.
* **Small team, global surface area**. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office.
* **The problem keeps compounding.** Expanding into input tax, withholding, e\-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead.

  

**THE ROLE**
------------


Sphere is looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build our outbound sales engine.


You'll work directly with our Account Executives and Founder to identify the companies we should be selling to, understand why Sphere matters to them, and create opportunities with CFOs, Controllers, Tax leaders, and other senior finance executives.


This isn't a role where you'll inherit a finished playbook and spend your day running someone else's sequences. You'll be expected to prospect relentlessly, learn quickly, experiment with what works, and help us build the playbook as we go.

**This role is designed to be a path into an Account Executive position at Sphere.** You'll get exposure to the full sales cycle from day one, learn directly from our AEs and the founder, and take on more responsibility as you prove you're ready. We want to develop our next generation of AEs from within.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Build and own targeted account lists across our core markets.
* Prospect into CFOs, Controllers, Heads of Tax, and other senior finance leaders.
* Research companies to understand their business model, global footprint, and why Sphere could matter to them.
* Create pipeline through phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and creative outbound.
* Work directly with AEs on account strategy, messaging, and multithreading.
* Learn how to qualify real business problems rather than simply book meetings.
* Get exposure to discovery, demos, deal strategy, negotiation, and closing.
* Take on increasing ownership of opportunities as you develop.
* Experiment constantly with messaging, targeting, signals, and new ways to create pipeline.
* Help build the outbound playbook that future SDRs at Sphere will inherit.

  

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

* You want to build a career in B2B sales and eventually own a number.
* You're a strong communicator and comfortable starting conversations with people more senior than you.
* You're competitive, curious, and willing to put in the reps.
* You learn quickly and actively seek feedback.
* You're comfortable operating in an environment where the answer isn't always obvious.
* You take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.
* You're excited to work alongside the team in our San Francisco office five days a week.

  

**NICE TO HAVES**
-----------------

* Previous SDR experience is helpful, but not required. We're more interested in trajectory than pedigree.
* Previous outbound sales or prospecting experience.
* Experience at an early stage startup.
* Experience selling or working with Finance, Accounting, or Tax teams.
* Evidence that you've been exceptional at something competitive, whether that's sales, athletics, academics, entrepreneurship, or something else.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

*You'll thrive here if:*

* **You're a Dog.** You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: *good, that means the opportunity is ours.* Hunger beats pedigree.
* **Early stage is in your bones.** You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.
* **You own it end to end.** Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.
* **You believe speed and accuracy are both possible.** We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.
* **Being in the room is a feature, not a cost.** Five days in SF isn't a policy, it's how the work gets done. The speed and density of collaboration we need doesn't survive over video.

 *This won't be a fit if:*

* You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating
* You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)
* You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)
* Being in the room five days a week feels like a cost instead of a benefit

Provides support to Regional Director/Market Leader. Perform various duties that are necessary to support high volume regional leasing/marketing activities. In doing so understands the Leasing section of the Operations Manual, The FR Way, and utilizes the information to assist the Regional Director/Market Leader in maximizing occupancy and property cash flows. Coordinates marketing related projects with Corporate Marketing. Performs other administrative duties as assigned. **Essential Job Functions**  

* Generates form leases and amendments and other legal documentation for all leasing activity, including, but not limited to Commencement Confirmation Letters, Confidentiality Agreements, Commission Agreements and etc.
* Collect market information; assist in conducting, compiling, and presenting marketing analyses; compile and analyze data and put in presentable form for the Regional Director/Market Leader.
* Generates Lease Analysis Forms, pulls D \& B reports and other tenant credit information needed to generate Financial Review form for lease approval. Compiles all required documents necessary for approval.

* Process executed Leases; forward to appropriate departments, upload approval and etc.
* Responsible for digital filing as required for internal document storage of Leasing and Property Management documents, as assigned.
* Maintains internal marketing database; and interact with brokers, customers and management.
* Assist with marketing campaigns, internal and external marketing initiatives, coordinating details associated with various marketing projects; contact and work with Corporate Marketing in the execution of all marketing projects.
* Create and update space availability flyers; broadcast emails to brokers including monthly availability reports.
* Work with Corporate Marketing, assist in developing marketing packages, brochures, drip mail campaign literature design, and presentations; prepare proposals.
* Manage FR marketing piece inventory, order marketing boards for vacancies and work with region team to manage and maintain electronic floor plans.
* Draft communication for Regional Director/Market Leader including correspondence to tenants on renewal intentions and move out letters. When Regional Director/Market Leader is away, receive calls and help with literature, etc. and inform Regional Director/Market Leader.
* Schedule and organize broker events.
* Generate and maintain database related to broker listing agreements. Track expiration dates and proactively manage listing contract renewals.
* Process broker commission agreements and broker commission payments.
* Establish and maintain database of competitive properties for availabilities and rates, broken down by vacant suite and submarket.
* Track lease deals and submit to Corporate Marketing for press releases.
* Track FR marketing budget vs. actual dollars spent per ad type.
* Maintain all leasing related documentation and reports for staff meetings including deal tracking spreadsheet
* Organize vacancy cleaning with Regional Team for monthly tasks by vendor
* Show space to prospects as needed.
* Provide administrative support to office staff, including coordinating travel arrangements, preparing expense reports, scheduling meetings and conference calls, and preparing related correspondence and reports.
* Perform general office and administrative duties, including updating and maintaining spreadsheets and databases, preparing client/partner presentations, creating and maintaining filing systems, assisting with document inventories, and assisting with other general administrative needs and special projects as assigned.
* Responsible for compliance with all related policies and procedures as outlined in the Operations Manual, The FR Way.
 **Other Duties*** Other tasks and duties as assigned. This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
 **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**  

* Knowledge of general leasing/marketing concepts and practices at a level normally acquired through completion of four to five years of related work experience necessary to gain knowledge of real estate leasing/marketing techniques.
* Good interpersonal and telephone communication skills.
* Good written, editing, and communication skills including ability to prepare accurate and appropriate documentation; excellent grammar, punctuation and spelling skills.
* Have excellent computer skills.
 **Physical Requirements**  

* Work requires occasionally lifting and/or carrying objects weighing up to 10 pounds when preparing advertising materials for open houses, etc.
* Work requires frequently stooping and bending to store, retrieve, package, and ship marketing materials and promotional items.
* Work requires walking and/or standing for extended periods of time when attending broker events and “open houses”.
* Work is typically performed in a normal office environment where there are relatively few physical discomforts due to dust, dirt, noise, and the like.
* Work requires occasional travel within the portfolio.
 **Equal Employment Opportunity**  

First Industrial Realty Trust, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer Committed to Diversity, M/F/D/V

**Position:** **Technical Operations Coordinator**


Department: Operations / Technical Operations


Reports To: IT Systems Solutions Manager


Location: 3180 Presidential Dr, Atlanta, GA 30340

 **Summary:**


LifeLine Animal Project is committed to the care and welfare of pets and the people who love them. The values we exhibit as an organization show the strength of our staff, our leadership and our community. We expect all employees to exhibit LifeLine’s core values as we complete daily tasks, provide services to clients and care for our animals.


The Technical Operations Coordinator plans and coordinates reliable, secure, and effective


technology operations across LifeLine Animal Project. The role’s primary focus is organization\-wide


technology planning, asset lifecycle management, systems administration, vendor coordination,


staff enablement, and operational improvement. The Coordinator also ensures that employees


receive responsive technology support and that recurring issues inform longer\-term solutions.


Reporting to the IT Systems Solutions Manager, the Coordinator manages assigned priorities with


substantial day\-to\-day autonomy, evaluates competing operational needs, determines appropriate


courses of action within delegated authority, and recommends solutions that affect multiple


locations and departments. The position serves employees at all LifeLine locations and remote staff


and is the first point of contact for troubleshooting county\-owned equipment at county\-affiliated


locations before escalation to the appropriate County IT department.

**Essential Job Functions:**

*This represents a list of essential job duties. Other duties or special projects may be assigned as needed.*

**Save Lives \- Build Community \- Be Exceptional Stewards \- Be Courageous \-**

* Serve as the primary LifeLine contact for county\-owned technology equipment at county\-affiliated locations; troubleshoot issues, document findings, and escalate to County IT when appropriate.
* Coordinate and provide timely desktop, software, account, network, phone, and peripheral support with ***compassion*** to onsite and remote staff, balancing immediate service needs with organization\-wide priorities.

* Follow approved information\-security, access\-control, data\-handling, and equipment\-management practices; promptly report suspected security incidents or policy exceptions.
* ***Take responsibility*** to document recurring issues, resolutions, configurations, and support procedures to improve consistency and reduce future disruption.
* Design and deliver practical technology onboarding and training for new and current staff, including job aids and reference materials.
* Consult with departments to evaluate workflow needs, identify technology barriers, compare available solutions, and implement or recommend improvements within approved systems and resources, supporting our effort to ***save lives***.
* Support adoption of new software and improved data\-collection practices by assisting with setup, testing, training, troubleshooting, and documentation.

* Collect user feedback and monitor recurring support trends to inform planning, training, equipment standards, and process improvements.

Description:

Position Summary


Responsible for maximizing the sales and marketing of supplier brands in assigned accounts through consultative sales techniques, the building of strong relationships with key decision makers and effective planning, selling, merchandising and communication that permits achievement of company and supplier objectives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Solicit products in a defined route area while operating a company vehicle.
* Product is counted and ordered in each account into a laptop using the Encompass software package.
* Manage, rotate and maintain a neat inventory in each account.
* Must sell sufficient product inventory to eliminate out\-of\-stock situations
* Seek and develop positive working relationships with our retail partners.
* Identify new opportunities to grow our existing portfolio
* Develop and implement sales promotions to encourage distribution and product growth
* Establish a close working relationship with all retail partners
* Responsible for ensuring marketing and sales support materials are displayed in each retail outlet.
* Secure the best possible selling position for our products (including primary displays, coolers, etc.)
* Place all brand POS materials including neons, glassware, paper goods, and display enhancers in order to establish a “look of the leader”.
* Conduct special promotions within accounts to increase brands sales.
* Call on account to establish sales promotions thru displays and samplings
* Maintain strong lines of communication with Driver to execute daily duties and merchandising expectations.
* Operate company vehicle safely and according to policy.
* Actively supports the Company’s mission and vision philosophy.
* Attends all required Company meetings.
* Employee initiates and actively participates in personal growth and development plans.
* Works with all co\-workers to ensure a safe working environment.
* Maintains security and confidentiality of all Company information.
* Understands and complies with all Eagle Rock Distributing Company policies and procedures.


Requirements:

Education and Experience

* High school diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Prior sales experience preferred
* Prior experience in the beverage alcohol industry and/or distribution preferred


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

* Must be able to meet company MVR and insurability standard
* Exhibits a sense of urgency to achieve timely, quality results
* Effectively manages multiple tasks and priorities
* Works effectively individually or in a team environment
* Remains highly organized in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to quickly learn and effectively utilize product knowledge, sales techniques and account characteristics,
* Adheres closely to company policies and procedure and all relevant laws
* Communicates clearly, proactively and effectively with co\-workers, leadership, suppliers and accounts
* Displays strong customer service skills
* Possesses strong attention to detail
* Exercises sound judgement in decision\-making
* Takes initiative to complete regular responsibilities, assigned tasks and achieve goals
* Able to learn and is competent in using technology that includes, but is not limited to: tablets, cell phones, standard office equipment, current operating systems, sales and warehouse management software and email software


Physical Demands and Requirements

* Requires frequent sitting, standing, walking, bending/crouching and reaching in front and above the head
* May require sitting or standing for extended periods of time
* Regularly lifts and carries items weighing up to 30 lbs.
* Occasionally lifts, pushes or pulls items up to 70 lbs. (with or without assistance)


Environmental Conditions

* Job duties are primarily performed inside and outside customer accounts
* Occasional work in an office and/or warehouse environment is required
* Experiences exposure to varying temperatures and weather conditions


Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review
**Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review**


As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process.AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate’s qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

new_jobs.title: Belgard Sales Representative (Hardscapes)
new_jobs.description:
Job ID: 528505

  

Oldcastle, a CRH company, is reinventing what's possible in building solutions. We are the leading provider of innovative outdoor living products and utility infrastructure solutions for the water, energy, and communications markets throughout North America. We're a trusted and strategic partner to engineers, contractors, distributors, specifiers, retailers, and homeowners alike as the manufacturer of precast concrete, polymer concrete, and plastic infrastructure products. Our portfolio of brands includes Oldcastle APG, Oldcastle Infrastructure, Belgard® hardscape, Echelon® Masonry, RDI® railing, Catalyst™ Fence Solutions, Sakrete® packaged concrete, Amerimix® mortar, Pebble Technology International® pool finishes, and Techniseal® sands and sealant technologies.  



**Job Summary**

  

Oldcastle APG is seeking a results\-driven, relationship\-oriented Belgard Sales Representative to join our high\-performing team in the Northwest Georgia Metro region. In this pivotal role, you’ll take the lead on growing and maintaining a multi\-million\-dollar territory—serving as a trusted advisor to customers, contractors, and dealers. You’ll have the autonomy to build your own success while backed by the strength, innovation, and support of a national industry leader.

  

As a Belgard Sales Representative, you’ll be the face of our brand—managing existing customer relationships, uncovering new business opportunities, and helping clients bring their outdoor visions to life. You’ll leverage your knowledge of the construction or building materials industry to drive results in a competitive, fast\-paced environment.

 **Job Location**

  

* This position is remote, and this person needs to live in Northwest Georgia.
 **Job Responsibilities**

  

* Grow and Maintain Customer Relationships \- Build trust with existing customers, understand their evolving needs, and increase sales through service excellence and strategic insight.
* Prospect and Develop New Business \- Identify new leads, engage prospective customers, and expand Belgard’s footprint in the region through proactive outreach and innovative selling techniques.
* Strategize for Success \- Collaborate with contractors and dealers to craft tailored sales strategies that meet client goals and market demands.
* Stay Ahead of Market Trends \- Analyze local and regional market dynamics to stay competitive and capitalize on new opportunities.
* Be Data\-Driven \- Prepare sales reports, track prospecting activities, and translate dealer sales data into actionable insights that support smarter production planning.
* Close with Confidence \- Provide accurate quotes, credit terms, and formalize sales contracts, ensuring clarity and alignment with client expectations.
* Adapt and Collaborate \- Perform related duties and contribute to company success as needed, across sales, logistics, and customer service functions.

 **Job Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in sales, business, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience managing multi\-million\-dollar sales territory, ideally in building materials or construction industries.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals in a territory\-based role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills—you’re just as comfortable presenting to executives as you are speaking with contractors.
* Strong understanding of CRM systems and sales reporting tools.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel overnight as needed.
* Willingness to lift products up to 50 lbs. during demonstrations or events.
* Home office required – this is a field\-based role with a lot of time spent on the road.
* Bilingual in Spanish and English to better serve a diverse customer base. (preferred)

 **Compensation**

  

* Base Salary $40,000\-$45,000 plus commissions, annual earnings between $100,000\-$110,000
* Monthly car allowance
* 401(k) plan / group retirement savings program
* Short\-term and long\-term disability benefits
* Life insurance
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays
 **What CRH Offers You**

  

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

  

**About CRH**

  

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

  

If you’re up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!

  



Oldcastle APG, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.

  

EOE/Vet/Disability

  

CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

  

AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**


Asset Living is a third\-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single\-family home rentals, affordable housing, build\-to\-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.  



  

Asset Living is a fast\-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.  



  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

 **COMMUNITY MANAGER**


The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire operations of a housing community under the supervision of the Regional Manager. As a Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration \& risk management. As an on\-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with Asset’s policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

* Personnel Management
* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques \& company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop on\-site staff
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Complete weekly/daily office \& maintenance staff schedules and assignments
* Deal effectively and consistently with performance problems; document adequately, communicate with direct supervisor and HR, and terminate appropriately when necessary.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures
* Financial Management
* Achieve the highest possible net operating income through the implementation of effective cost control and revenue \& leasing improvement; identify trends and recommend strategies and adjustments
* Develop yearly operating budgets/forecasts
* Monitor the timely receipt and reconciliation of deposits, rent collections, and charges to ensure they are submitted on a timely basis.
* Monitor the timely receipt, reconciliation, and coding of all vendor invoices
* Ensure property closeout is completed on time and ownership financial reports are accurate
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Develop yearly marketing plan and utilize marketing strategies \& systems
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow\-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents
* Administrative \& Maintenance Management
* Ensure all administrative \& leasing reporting is accurate, complete, and submitted on a timely basis
* Will head emergency team for the property; ensure proper response and handling of all property emergencies with staff, residents, buildings, etc., within company guidelines to minimize liability.
* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, and contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)
* Give direction to and monitor maintenance, construction, and rehabilitation activities to ensure quality and expediency (i.e., “walk” units to ensure make\-ready and work orders are completed)

* Ability to understand and perform all on\-site software functions; basic computer skills required.

Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

 **ASSISTANT COMMUNITY MANAGER**


The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for overseeing, under the supervision of the Community Manager, the everyday operations and financial functions of the housing community. As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration \& risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an onsite leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

 **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

  

Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non\-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non\-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end\-of\-the\-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move\-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

  

Personnel Management

* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques \& company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow\-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies \& systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

  

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Assist with supervision of all business functions related to operations.
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

Chicago Human Rhythm Project (CHRP) is the nation’s largest and only year\-round presenter of American tap dance and contemporary percussive arts. We are seeking a Marketing Communications and Development Coordinator to lead Marketing and Communication for CHRP’s programs and events, and to assist with fundraising, grant management, and donor and board relations. This role is great for a motivated individual with great communication and organizational skills, and a knack for graphic design who is looking to advance a career in Arts Administration.

**About the Mayfair Arts Center** 

A project of Chicago Human Rhythm Project, the Mayfair Arts Center (MAC) is a collaborative effort to foster community growth through rhythmic expression.
